summary: LLM developers post-train their models to exhibit prosocial values and behavioral traits, which are enumerated in an alignment target. However, while recent post-training developments have yielded models that score highly on alignment evaluations, training models on sets of narrow behaviors still influences their behavior across unseen contexts and environments in unexpected ways. In this paper, we establish the task of alignment generalization prediction, i.e., predicting how fine-tuning a model to follow a given value changes its behavior across a wide range of held-out values. We conduct a large-scale analysis of alignment generalization effects across 66 values found in modern alignment targets, and benchmark representational techniques on the alignment generalization prediction task. We find that representations based on model activations when applying values in context significantly outperform methods based on textual descriptions of the values. Specifically, the best activations-based methods achieve correlations of 0.45 with our generalization matrix, compared with 0.05 from description-based baselines. We then show the applicability of representations that predict alignment generalization toward downstream tasks by using them to measure how similar the values in a multi-value alignment target are, which we find is significantly correlated with model robustness. Finally, we show initial evidence towards a shared, model-independent value space, which we use to develop the first taxonomy of LLM values grounded in empirical generalization dynamics. Our work demonstrates the importance of studying value generalization in LLMs and its application toward the more empirical design and training of model behavior.
title: Predicting Alignment Generalization with Value Representations
title_translated: 基于价值表示预测对齐泛化
summary_translated: 大型语言模型（LLM）开发者在后训练阶段使模型表现出亲社会价值观和行为特征，这些内容被列在对齐目标中。然而，尽管近期的后训练方法已使模型在对齐评估中得分较高，但在一组狭窄行为上进行训练仍会以不可预见的方式影响其在未见情境和环境中的行为。本文提出了对齐泛化预测任务，即预测微调模型以遵循特定价值时，其行为在大量未见价值上的变化。我们对现代对齐目标中66个价值进行了大规模分析，并在对齐泛化预测任务上基准了多种表示技术。结果发现，基于上下文应用价值时模型激活值的表示方法显著优于基于价值文本描述的方法。具体而言，最佳激活值方法与我们的泛化矩阵相关性达到0.45，而基于描述的基线仅为0.05。随后，我们展示了能够预测对齐泛化的表示在下游任务中的适用性，例如通过它们衡量多价值对齐目标中各价值之间的相似性，发现该相似性与模型鲁棒性显著相关。最后，我们初步揭示了一个共享且模型无关的价值空间，并据此构建了首个基于经验泛化动态的LLM价值分类体系。本研究强调了研究LLM中价值泛化的重要性及其在更实证化地设计和训练模型行为方面的应用。

summary: Tokenizers are commonly optimized for compression, but a compact vocabulary does not necessarily distribute its capacity evenly across languages. We introduce the Latent Core Tokenizer (LCT), a language-agnostic approach that separates structural discovery from vocabulary construction. LCT uses Minimum Description Length, entropy-based boundary signals, and morphotactic constraints to identify reusable linguistic units before constructing a shared vocabulary. Across 104 languages with a 200K-token vocabulary, LCT achieves lower fertility and higher MorphScore than BPE, Unigram, and parity-aware BPE, while maintaining comparable cross-lingual disparity in tokenization cost. Across four multilingual downstream benchmarks, LCT improves aggregate score by 1.48, 1.83, and 2.00 points over BPE, Unigram, and parity-aware BPE, respectively. Our findings show that compression alone does not predict representation quality and highlight the importance of morphology-driven structural discovery and how frequency is used to allocate the final vocabulary across languages.
title: Latent Core Tokenizer: Compress, but Meaningfully
title_translated: 潜在核心分词器：有意义地压缩
summary_translated: 分词器通常以压缩为目标进行优化，但紧凑的词汇表并不一定在不同语言间均匀分配容量。我们提出了一种无语言依赖的潜在核心分词器（LCT），将结构发现与词汇构建分离。LCT利用最小描述长度、基于熵的边界信号以及形态句法约束，在构建共享词汇表之前识别可复用的语言单元。在104种语言、20万词表规模下，LCT在繁殖率（fertility）和形态评分（MorphScore）方面均优于BPE、Unigram及兼顾公平性的BPE，同时保持了相近的跨语言分词成本差异。在四个多语言下游基准测试中，LCT分别比BPE、Unigram和兼顾公平性的BPE提升了1.48、1.83和2.00分。研究结果表明，仅追求压缩并不能预测表示质量，强调了基于形态学的结构发现以及频率如何用于分配最终词汇表的重要性。

summary: Skills, reusable procedural guidance added at inference, can substantially improve LLM downstream performance (Li et al., 2026). Prior work retrieves skills from a bank by semantic relevance, then uses them as inference-time patches or for model distillation. The individual utility of each skill, however, is largely neglected. We first show that, in on-policy distillation where skill-conditioned policies serve as teachers, fewer than 25% of retrieved skills provide useful distillation signals. We then propose SGUID, a method for selecting a compact subset of skills for distillation. SGUID retains a skill only if it consistently yields effective learning signals during training. The selected skills are then distilled to produce a better model. Our results show that not all skills are worth distilling. Across four models from the Olmo and Qwen families, distilling 6 selected skills matches or exceeds full-bank distillation in mean avg@12 on three of the four models, and on all four after a second round that distills 3 newly selected skills, while the full banks are up to 11x larger. Importantly, SGUID supports stable model-skill co-evolution: after a distillation round, a new candidate bank is curated from the updated model's rollouts, and SGUID selects which skills to internalize next. In the second round, this loop selects 3 new skills and improves Qwen3-8B from 64.3% to 66.3%. The selection step is essential for stability: on Qwen3-4B, naively updating the model with unfiltered skills degrades performance, including a 0.3 percentage point drop on HMMT25, whereas SGUID improves HMMT25 by 0.5 points after the first round and 1.1 points after the second. These results identify skill selection as the key mechanism for stable model-skill co-evolution.
title: Which Skill to Distill? SGUID: Selecting a Compact Skill Bank for Model-Skill Co-Evolution
title_translated: 应蒸馏何种技能？SGUID：为模型-技能共演化选择紧凑技能库
summary_translated: 技能是推理时添加的可复用过程指导，能显著提升大型语言模型的下游性能（Li等，2026）。以往工作通过语义相关性从技能库中检索技能，然后作为推理时的补丁或用于模型蒸馏。然而，每个技能的个体效用常被忽视。我们首先发现，在策略内蒸馏中，以技能条件策略为教师时，少于25%的检索到的技能提供了有效的蒸馏信号。为此，我们提出SGUID方法，用于选择一个紧凑的技能子集进行蒸馏。SGUID仅保留那些在训练过程中持续提供有效学习信号的技能。所选技能被蒸馏后生成更优模型。实验显示，并非所有技能都值得蒸馏。在Olmo和Qwen系列的四个模型上，蒸馏6个精选技能在三个模型上的平均@12指标达到或超过全库蒸馏效果，而在所有四个模型上经过第二轮蒸馏（新增3个精选技能）后全面超越，而全库规模最大可达11倍。重要的是，SGUID支持稳定的模型-技能共演化：每轮蒸馏后，从更新模型的回放轨迹中重新构建候选技能库，SGUID再决定下一步内化哪些技能。第二轮中，该循环选出了3个新技能，使Qwen3-8B性能从64.3%提升至66.3%。选择步骤至关重要：在Qwen3-4B上，若直接使用未经筛选的技能更新模型，性能下降，包括HMMT25下降0.3个百分点；而SGUID在第一轮提升HMMT25 0.5分，第二轮提升1.1分。这些结果表明，技能选择是实现稳定模型-技能共演的核心机制。

summary: While caching key-value (KV) states accelerates Large Language Model (LLM) decoding, this cache can dominate memory usage at long context lengths. One solution is to compress this memory by exploiting inter-layer cache similarities. However, most existing techniques necessitate architectural changes to LLMs and incur substantial overhead. In this work, we propose a symmetry-aware value cache merging strategy that reduces cache memory while avoiding both harmful performance degradation and architectural overhead during decoding. Furthermore, we show that this approach can be exploited alongside existing cache compression techniques, composing with high-ratio quantization or key cache pruning to reach compression ratios that neither method reaches alone, with minimal additional cost. Ultimately, our findings reveal a major source of underutilized capacity in the value cache, offering a simple yet highly effective direction for scaling context windows under memory constraints.
title: VFold: Symmetry-Aware Cross-Layer Value Cache Compression
title_translated: VFold：面向对称性的跨层值缓存压缩
summary_translated: 虽然缓存键值（KV）状态可加速大语言模型（LLM）解码，但在长上下文长度下，该缓存可能主导内存使用。一种解决方案是利用层间缓存相似性来压缩内存。然而，大多数现有技术需要修改LLM架构并带来显著开销。本文提出一种面向对称性的值缓存合并策略，在减少缓存内存的同时避免解码过程中的性能下降和架构开销。此外，我们还证明该方法可与现有缓存压缩技术结合使用，与高比率量化或键缓存剪枝组合，实现单一方法无法达到的压缩率，且额外成本极低。最终，我们的研究揭示了值缓存中一个主要的未充分利用容量，为在内存受限条件下扩展上下文窗口提供了简单而高效的路径。

summary: Text-to-SQL models are commonly trained to map questions directly to static queries, whereas real-world database agents operate through stateful, multi-turn interaction with live databases -- inspecting schemas, executing probe queries, diagnosing errors, and revising hypotheses. This creates a critical train-deploy mismatch, as the execution harness that mediates this interaction is introduced only at inference time. To bridge this gap, we propose HarnessSQL, a harness-native post-training framework that preserves the full interaction structure throughout both supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning. HarnessSQL builds isolated, executable database environments paired with hidden execution oracles, rolls out teachers directly inside the target SQL harness, and retains only verified trajectories for full-sequence SFT, followed by execution-reward RL. Across Spider 2.0-SQLite, HarnessSQL dramatically boosts the execution accuracy of compact models, raising Qwen3-8B from 15.5% to 45.2% and Qwen3-14B from 22.2% to 54.8%, while transferring effectively to out-of-distribution interactive benchmarks such as BIRD-Interact and LiveSQLBench. Our findings demonstrate that training database agents directly within their execution harness is essential for mastering complex, long-horizon database workflows.
title: HarnessSQL: Harness-Native Training for SQL Agents in Realistic Database Environments
title_translated: HarnessSQL：在真实数据库环境中针对SQL智能体的原生训练
summary_translated: 文本到SQL模型通常被训练为将问题直接映射到静态查询，而现实世界中的数据库智能体则需通过与实时数据库的状态化、多轮交互来操作——包括检查模式、执行探测查询、诊断错误并修正假设。这造成了严重的训练-部署不匹配，因为中介交互的执行框架仅在推理阶段引入。为弥合这一差距，我们提出HarnessSQL，一种原生保留完整交互结构的后训练框架，贯穿监督微调和强化学习全过程。HarnessSQL构建隔离的可执行数据库环境，并配备隐藏的执行预言机，将教师直接部署在目标SQL框架内部，仅保留经验证的轨迹用于全序列SFT，随后进行基于执行奖励的强化学习。在Spider 2.0-SQLite数据集上，HarnessSQL显著提升了紧凑模型的执行准确率，使Qwen3-8B从15.5%提升至45.2%，Qwen3-14B从22.2%提升至54.8%，并在BIRD-Interact和LiveSQLBench等分布外交互基准上实现有效迁移。研究结果表明，在其执行框架内直接训练数据库智能体对于掌握复杂、长周期的数据库工作流至关重要。

summary: Wearable augmented reality (AR) assistants are moving toward continuous real-world interaction, where they perceive the user's activity through first-person video and audio and provide timely spoken guidance without being explicitly asked. While proactive video assistants, spoken dialog systems, and egocentric task understanding have each advanced rapidly, existing systems do not address the joint problem of deciding when to speak and what to say from continuous first-person streams. We introduce EgoVoice, a framework for training and evaluating proactive egocentric spoken assistants. From HoloAssist video recordings of real human instructors, we construct clean audio streams through source separation and speech resynthesis, and convert each video session into a format where the model must decide at each moment whether to remain silent or provide spoken guidance. We fine-tune an omni-modal LLM with our data, and further improve its proactive intervention behavior with direct preference optimization. Experiments across closed and open-source models show that existing systems rarely produce well-timed, meaningful proactive interventions, while EgoVoice yields clear improvements in intervention timing, content relevance, and human preference over the zero-shot backbone.
title: EgoVoice: Proactive Spoken Assistance from Egocentric Multimodal Streams
comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026 (Main Conference). 25 pages, 12 figures, 11 tables. Project page: this https URL
title_translated: EgoVoice：来自第一人称多模态流的主动语音辅助
summary_translated: 可穿戴增强现实（AR）助手正朝着持续的现实世界交互发展，它们通过第一人称视频和音频感知用户活动，并在无需明确请求的情况下提供及时的语音指导。尽管主动视频助手、语音对话系统和第一人称任务理解各自取得了快速进展，但现有系统尚未解决如何从连续的第一人称流中决定何时说话以及说什么这一联合问题。我们提出了EgoVoice，一个用于训练和评估主动第一人称语音助手的框架。基于真实人类导师的HoloAssist视频记录，我们通过源分离和语音重建构建了清晰的音频流，并将每个视频会话转换为模型必须在每一时刻决定保持沉默或提供语音指导的格式。我们使用数据微调了一个全模态大语言模型，并通过直接偏好优化进一步提升了其主动干预行为。在闭源和开源模型上的实验表明，现有系统很少能产生时机恰当、有意义的主动干预，而EgoVoice在干预时机、内容相关性和人类偏好方面均显著优于零样本基线模型。

summary: Large language model (LLM) routing distributes inference work across different models, advancing the cost-quality Pareto frontier of LLM serving. While coarse-grained routing at the session or query level has been widely adopted in production systems, recent algorithmic work shows that fine-grained token-level routing can yield substantial efficiency and quality gains. However, efficiently serving token-level routed inference poses significant challenges to existing systems. Built on single-LLM assumptions, current systems suffer from severe step desynchronization and frequent batch admission delays under token-level routing, and they also impose high implementation complexity on developers. To address these challenges, we design TokenRouter, an efficient and developer-friendly serving system for token-level routed LLM inference. TokenRouter follows the principle of request-centric programming, model-centric execution: developers describe routing logic from the perspective of a single request, while the runtime launches a subserver for each LLM and dispatches requests asynchronously. Each subserver employs a delayed-batching scheduler, whose optimal hyperparameters are derived from a mathematical throughput model of the system. Across diverse routing algorithms, workloads, and model pairs, TokenRouter achieves 2.01-64.15x higher decoding throughput than existing systems, substantially advancing the serving efficiency of token-level LLM routing. Our code is available at https://github.com/thu-nics/TokenRouter.
title: TokenRouter: Efficient Serving System for Token-Level LLM Routing
title_translated: TokenRouter：面向令牌级大语言模型路由的高效服务系统
summary_translated: 大语言模型（LLM）路由通过在不同模型间分配推理任务，推动了LLM服务的成本-质量帕累托前沿。虽然粗粒度的会话或查询级别路由已在生产系统中广泛采用，但近期算法研究表明，细粒度的令牌级路由可带来显著的效率与质量提升。然而，高效支持令牌级路由推理对现有系统构成了重大挑战。当前系统基于单LLM假设，在令牌级路由下存在严重的步骤不同步和频繁的批处理延迟问题，且对开发者而言实现复杂度较高。为解决这些问题，我们设计了TokenRouter——一个面向令牌级路由LLM推理的高效且开发者友好的服务系统。TokenRouter遵循请求中心编程、模型中心执行的原则：开发者从单个请求的角度描述路由逻辑，而运行时为每个LLM启动子服务器并异步分发请求。每个子服务器采用延迟批处理调度器，其最优超参数由系统的数学吞吐量模型推导得出。在多种路由算法、工作负载和模型组合下，TokenRouter的解码吞吐量比现有系统高出2.01至64.15倍，显著提升了令牌级LLM路由的服务效率。代码已公开于https://github.com/thu-nics/TokenRouter。

summary: AI research agents automate the cycle of proposing, implementing, and evaluating experiments, opening a path toward recursive self-improvement. Yet their ability to propose experiments outpaces their capacity to execute them in real environments, making outcome prediction a key capability for sustained self-improvement under limited experimental budgets. We investigate language models as Research World Models (RWMs), which predict the outcomes of candidate interventions across research environments. Our evaluation draws on over 2,600 experimental records from nine research environments spanning pretraining, post-training, and inference, representing more than 171,000 H100 GPU-hours of experimentation. Research knowledge acquired from real experimental experience improves RWM predictions of unseen interventions within the same environment (Spearman +0.27), and can be reused across environments. For example, using only pretraining experience from OLMo3, Marin, and Nanochat, an RWM reduces selection regret in the Qwen3 environment by 78% compared with zero-experience setting. These benefits extend to multi-round Autoresearch under a fixed selection budget: RWMs with in-env and cross-env research knowledge increase the best gain achieved by 15.8% and 11.6%, respectively. Ablations across 13 language models used as RWMs show that adding research knowledge can improve intervention ranking more than changing models or increasing reasoning effort alone. These findings support language models as RWMs and motivate accumulating experimental data for future RWM training.
title: Language Models as AI Research World Models
title_translated: 语言模型作为人工智能研究世界模型
summary_translated: 人工智能研究代理能够自动化提出、实施和评估实验的循环，为递归自我改进开辟了道路。然而，其提出实验的能力远超其在真实环境中执行实验的能力，因此在有限实验预算下进行结果预测成为持续自我改进的关键能力。我们研究了语言模型作为研究世界模型（RWMs），用于预测在各类研究环境中候选干预措施的结果。我们的评估基于来自九个研究环境的超过2600条实验记录，涵盖预训练、后训练和推理阶段，代表了超过17.1万小时的H100 GPU计算时间。从真实实验经验中获得的研究知识能够提升RWM对同一环境中未见干预的预测性能（Spearman相关性+0.27），并且可跨环境复用。例如，仅使用OLMo3、Marin和Nanochat的预训练经验，RWM在Qwen3环境中相比零经验设置可将选择遗憾降低78%。这些优势也延伸至固定选择预算下的多轮自动研究：具有环境内和跨环境研究知识的RWM分别使最佳收益提升15.8%和11.6%。对13种语言模型作为RWM的消融实验表明，加入研究知识对干预排序的提升效果超过单独更换模型或增加推理努力。这些发现支持语言模型作为RWM的有效性，并推动未来积累实验数据以用于RWM训练。

summary: Pre-trained transformer models are increasingly being used to study scientific and technological progress. Encoders tuned to paper or patent text outperform general-purpose models on downstream classification, regression, and proximity tasks within science and technology. However, the applicability of these models for studying time-dependent or archival properties of science, technology, and their interface is limited due to lookahead and domain biases inherent to these pre-trained models. These limitations arise from training on corpora with unconstrained chronological and text source distributions. We introduce SciTBERT: a family of chronologically consistent BERT-derived language models trained on text from scientific papers, patents, and high-quality educational web text with training data cutoff dates spanning each year between 2013 and 2025. We also post-train these models in a chronologically-consistent manner using paper and patent citations, creating SciTBERT-CI model family. We find that these models generally outperform predecessor domain-specific encoder models even when training data is limited by early year restrictions in the corpus. To further investigate the extent to which this class of models can learn representations that bridge science and technology, we introduce the PatRepEval benchmark, a suite of patent-related text embedding tasks at the science-technology interface. Performance in a variety of classification, regression, and retrieval tasks spanning papers and patents highlights the importance of aligning encoder model representations with the domain distributions of their downstream tasks, and chronologically consistent encoders can match or exceed models trained without temporal constraints.
title: SciTBERT: A family of chronologically consistent language models for scientific and technological language processing
title_translated: SciTBERT：一类时间一致的语言模型，用于科学与技术语言处理
summary_translated: 预训练Transformer模型正被越来越多地用于研究科学与技术进步。针对论文或专利文本微调的编码器在科学与技术领域的下游分类、回归和邻近性任务中表现优于通用模型。然而，由于这些预训练模型固有的前瞻性和领域偏差，其在研究具有时间依赖性或档案性质的科学、技术及其交叉领域的适用性受到限制。这些局限源于在无约束时间分布和文本来源分布的语料上进行训练。我们提出了SciTBERT：一类基于BERT衍生的时间一致语言模型家族，其训练数据涵盖科学论文、专利和高质量教育网络文本，训练数据截止日期覆盖2013年至2025年每年。我们还通过论文和专利引用以时间一致性方式对这些模型进行后训练，形成SciTBERT-CI模型族。我们发现，即使在语料库早期年份受限的情况下，这些模型通常仍优于先前的领域特定编码器模型。为进一步探究此类模型在弥合科学与技术之间表示能力方面的潜力，我们引入了PatRepEval基准测试，一套位于科学-技术交界处的专利相关文本嵌入任务。在涵盖论文和专利的多种分类、回归和检索任务中的表现凸显了将编码器模型表示与下游任务领域分布对齐的重要性，时间一致编码器能够匹配甚至超越无时间约束训练的模型。

summary: Tokenizer choice affects multilingual language modeling, but vocabulary capacity is finite and vocabulary size is often constrained: improving representation for some languages often comes at the expense of others. We therefore ask whether tokenizer choice matters equally across languages, a question that the current literature leave unanswered. To this end, we train 123 language models spanning 54 tokenizers. In the main comparison, architecture, training corpus, training-token budget, and optimization are held fixed, so the models differ only in their tokenizer. We find that tokenizer choice matters more for languages with less language-model training data: across the 54 tokenizers, the standard deviation of a language's bits-per-byte (BPB) increases as its model training-data share decreases (Spearman rho = -0.52 over the 31 trained languages and -0.69 over the 28 written with word boundaries). Leaving a language out of tokenizer training raises its BPB in every language we study, and the penalty tends to be larger for languages with less language-model training data. Giving lower-resource languages a larger share of tokenizer-training data, however, does not unconditionally help those languages: both equal weighting and an allocation inverting the shares with respect to the language model training data increase their BPB, particularly when language-model training repeats data. Finally, which intrinsic tokenizer properties are associated with better BPB differs across languages, providing further evidence that what makes a good tokenizer depends on the language. We find that the metrics quantifying these properties can be successfully used to predict downstream models' pairwise BPB rankings, suggesting a practical strategy for screening tokenizer candidates before training language models.
title: Language-Specific Effects of Tokenizer Choice in Multilingual Language Models
title_translated: 分词器选择对多语言语言模型的语言特异性影响
summary_translated: 分词器的选择会影响多语言语言建模，但由于词汇容量有限，词汇大小常受约束：提升某些语言的表示性能往往以牺牲其他语言为代价。因此我们提出疑问：分词器选择是否在所有语言中具有同等重要性？当前文献未能回答此问题。为此，我们训练了123个涵盖54种分词器的语言模型。在主要对比中，模型架构、训练语料、训练令牌预算和优化方法保持不变，仅分词器不同。我们发现，对于训练数据较少的语言，分词器选择的影响更大：在54种分词器中，语言的每字节比特数（BPB）的标准差随其模型训练数据占比下降而上升（31个训练语言的Spearman rho = -0.52，28个有词边界语言的Spearman rho = -0.69）。将某语言排除在分词器训练之外会提高该语言在所有研究语言中的BPB，且惩罚程度在低资源语言中更严重。然而，给予低资源语言更大的分词器训练数据份额并不总是有益：无论等权重分配还是反向分配（按语言模型训练数据比例反转），都会导致这些语言的BPB升高，尤其当语言模型训练重复数据时更为明显。此外，与更好BPB相关的分词器内在属性因语言而异，进一步证明优质分词器的定义取决于具体语言。我们发现，量化这些属性的指标可有效预测下游模型的成对BPB排名，提示了一种在训练前筛选分词器候选者的实用策略。

summary: Many key-value (KV) caches are compressed before anyone knows what will be asked of them: a document cached for retrieval, a prompt prefix shared across requests, the memory of a long conversation. The prevailing approach scores KV entries by rehearsal: the model rereads the context and keeps the entries it attends to, assuming that the more completely a cache rehearses its context, the better it remembers it. We show that under tight budgets this assumption backfires: rehearse everything, remember nothing. At a 3% keep ratio, rereading the whole context keeps 31.5 of 96.5 points on RULER, and on LongBench's natural-text tasks it falls below methods that rehearse nothing at all. The cause is that a cache keeps what it rehearses: rereading spreads the budget across the whole context, so the answer's own entries survive at little more than chance. Like a student before an exam, a cache remembers more by testing itself than by rereading. Two principles follow: rehearse what will be read, and rehearse as much as there is. We instantiate them as Attic-KV (Attic for short), a training-free rehearsal in which the model quizzes itself with question-answer pairs that quote the context, alongside anchor tokens in a content-adaptive amount. Changing only the rehearsal lifts three hosts that score it in three different ways: Attic alone is the best training-free method in all eight settings we test on RULER and LongBench's natural-text tasks, and plugged into the gradient-based KVgrad and the trained RestoreKV+, it raises them by up to 17.1 and 28.1 points. Its advantage grows as the budget shrinks, reaching 41.9 points over full rereading at a 3% keep ratio, and it compresses faster than rereading the whole context.
title: Rehearse Everything, Remember Nothing: Attic-KV Rehearses What Will Be Read
title_translated: 反复练习一切，却什么也记不住：Attic-KV 只复习将被读取的内容
summary_translated: 许多键值（KV）缓存会在人们知道具体查询内容之前就被压缩：用于检索的文档、跨请求共享的提示前缀、长时间对话的记忆。当前主流方法通过重复阅读来评分KV条目：模型重新阅读上下文并保留其关注的条目，假设缓存对上下文的重复越完整，记忆效果越好。我们发现，在严格预算下这一假设会适得其反：反复练习一切，反而什么也记不住。在3%的保留率下，完整重读上下文仅能获得RULER任务中96.5分中的31.5分，而在LongBench的自然文本任务上甚至低于完全不进行重读的方法。原因是缓存只记住它重读的内容：重复阅读将有限预算分散到整个上下文，导致答案本身的关键条目仅以略高于随机的概率留存。如同考试前的学生，缓存通过自我测试而非反复阅读来记得更多。由此得出两个原则：只复习将被读取的内容，且复习量应与实际需求相匹配。我们据此提出Attic-KV（简称Attic），一种无需训练的重读机制，模型通过引用上下文的问题-答案对自测，并以内容自适应的方式加入锚点标记。仅改变重读策略，便使三种不同评估方式下的系统性能全面提升：Attic在RULER和LongBench的自然文本任务中，八种测试场景下均为最佳无训练方法；接入基于梯度的KVgrad和训练好的RestoreKV+后，分别提升17.1和28.1分。随着预算缩减，其优势愈发明显，在3%保留率下比完整重读高出41.9分，且压缩速度优于完整重读。

summary: Automated methods have been proposed to overcome the limitations of human verbal deception detection, but evidence remains fragmented across disciplines. We systematically reviewed 25 years of research (289 reports, 6,136 classification models) and meta-analyzed 3,653 models nested within 97 datasets. Pooled accuracy was 74.4% (95% CI: 71.2%-77.4%) with substantial heterogeneity. Accuracy was driven by methodological quality (ground truth, data source, class balance, evaluation procedure) more than by model complexity: the adoption of embeddings and large language models has not translated into improved predictive performance. Only 12.46% of reports used data with verifiable ground-truth, and only 23.96% of models were evaluated on independent data. The pooled accuracy aligns with meta-analyses of manual approaches, suggesting a ceiling of 70-75%, unlikely to be lifted by current research conventions.
title: A persistent accuracy ceiling in automated verbal deception detection
title_translated: 自动化言语欺骗检测存在持续的准确率天花板
summary_translated: 尽管已提出多种自动化方法以克服人类言语欺骗检测的局限性，但相关证据仍分散于各学科之间。我们系统回顾了25年来的研究（共289篇报告，6,136个分类模型），并对97个数据集中的3,653个模型进行了元分析。综合准确率为74.4%（95%置信区间：71.2%-77.4%），异质性显著。准确率主要受方法学质量驱动（如真实标签、数据来源、类别平衡、评估流程），而非模型复杂度：嵌入表示和大语言模型的应用并未带来预测性能的提升。仅有12.46%的研究使用具有可验证真实标签的数据，仅23.96%的模型在独立数据上进行了评估。综合准确率与人工方法的元分析结果一致，表明存在70%-75%的天花板，当前研究范式难以突破。

summary: LLM-as-a-Judge is the standard paradigm for NLP evaluation, yet its systemic reliability remains poorly understood despite being widely treated as a deterministic ground truth. We present a comprehensive reliability audit, stresstesting six frontier models across four benchmarks, five prompt formats, two presentation orders, three sampling temperatures, and ten repetitions per condition. Our empirical analysis reveals severe vulnerabilities: verdicts change across identical replications at temperature zero, position-order swaps flip the majority of verdicts on challenging tasks, and the most deterministic judge achieves perfect consistency by trivially repeating incorrect verdicts, agreeing with ground truth only 51% of the time. To formalize these multi-faceted failure modes, we introduce the trustworthy verdict rate (T ), a unified metric capturing the joint probability that an evaluation is reproducible, order-invariant, and accurate. UsingT , we derive a theoretical upper bound on accuracy imposed by position bias and show that reliability is item-specific rather than modellevel. Finally, we demonstrate that shifting from pairwise win-rate to holistic rubric scoring improves trustworthiness more than any single-format prompting intervention, offering an actionable framework for robust NLP evaluation.
title: All Verdicts are Not Equal: Rethinking LLM Judge Reliability
title_translated: 所有判决并非都等同：重新思考大语言模型裁判的可靠性
summary_translated: LLM作为裁判是NLP评估的标准范式，但其系统性可靠性至今仍缺乏深入理解，尽管普遍被视为确定性的基准。我们对六款前沿模型进行了全面可靠性审计，涵盖四个基准、五种提示格式、两种呈现顺序、三种采样温度及每种条件十次重复。实证分析揭示严重脆弱性：在温度为零时，相同复现的判决仍发生变化；在挑战性任务上，位置顺序互换导致多数判决反转；最“确定”的裁判通过简单重复错误判决实现完美一致性，但与真实答案一致率仅为51%。为形式化这些多维度失败模式，我们引入可信判决率（T），一个统一指标，捕捉评估可复现性、顺序无关性和准确性三者的联合概率。利用T，我们推导出由位置偏差带来的准确率理论上限，并证明可靠性是具体项目相关的，而非模型层面的属性。最后，我们证明从成对胜率转向整体评分标准，能比任何单一提示干预更显著提升可信度，为构建稳健的NLP评估提供可操作框架。

summary: Digital technologies have made Islamic narratives more accessible, but existing platforms provide limited support for structured learning and comprehension of these stories, particularly in Arabic and multilingual settings. We present ILM, an interactive educational platform for Stories of the Prophets that combines Arabic natural language processing, structured knowledge representation, and retrieval-based question generation. Admin-approved Arabic narratives are processed by a Knowledge Graph (KG) Constructor Engine that identifies entities and narrative relationships and stores them as structured knowledge, enabling learners to explore stories through a visual story map and answer entity- and relation-based questions generated from the KG. Separately, a multilingual retrieval pipeline retrieves relevant passages from the original narratives to generate multiple-choice and open-ended comprehension questions. For open-ended questions, an LLM-as-a-Judge evaluates learners' answers against the retrieved passages and reference answers to determine correctness. The platform also incorporates Quranic content as a separate enrichment layer, allowing selected narratives to be supplemented with source-supported information. By combining structured knowledge with passage-based retrieval, ILM supports narrative exploration, comprehension, and assessment across Arabic and multilingual content. The system demonstrates the feasibility of combining structured knowledge representation and retrieval-based generation to support interactive learning of Islamic narratives. A demo is available at anonymous.4open.science/r/mml-5FCF.
title: ILM: An AI-Powered Storytelling Educational Tool
title_translated: ILM：一款人工智能驱动的叙事教育工具
summary_translated: 数字技术使伊斯兰叙事更加易得，但现有平台在结构化学习和理解方面支持有限，尤其在阿拉伯语及多语言环境中。我们提出ILM，一个交互式教育平台，专注于先知故事的学习。该平台结合阿拉伯语自然语言处理、结构化知识表示和基于检索的问题生成。经管理员审核的阿拉伯语叙事由知识图谱构造引擎处理，识别实体与叙事关系，并以结构化知识形式存储，使学习者可通过可视化故事地图探索故事，并回答基于知识图谱生成的实体与关系问题。此外，一个多语言检索管道从原始叙事中提取相关段落，生成选择题和开放题。对于开放题，采用LLM作为裁判，将学习者答案与检索段落和参考答案对比，判断正确性。平台还整合《古兰经》内容作为独立增强层，允许特定叙事补充有源支持的信息。通过结合结构化知识与基于段落的检索，ILM支持阿拉伯语及多语言内容的叙事探索、理解与评估。系统展示了将结构化知识表示与基于检索的生成相结合以支持互动式学习伊斯兰叙事的可行性。演示地址见 anonymous.4open.science/r/mml-5FCF。

summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have renewed interest in autoformalization. Yet, when First-Order Logic (FOL) is considered as the target formalism, the field still lacks a unified task formulation and a systematic survey. This paper addresses this gap: we first provide a principled definition for the FOL-autoformalization task by distinguishing Ontology Extraction from Logical Translation, showing how their conflation obscures (cross-study) evaluation; we review existing datasets, evaluation metrics, and LLM-based methods, including fine-tuning, prompting, and verification-based refinement; we identify open challenges in benchmarking, semantic evaluation, ontology-aware methods, and end-to-end applications.
title: Natural Language to First-Order Logic LLM-based Autoformalization
title_translated: 基于大语言模型的自然语言到一阶逻辑的自动形式化
summary_translated: 大语言模型（LLMs）重新激发了自动形式化的研究兴趣。然而，当一阶逻辑（FOL）作为目标形式化体系时，该领域仍缺乏统一的任务定义和系统性综述。本文填补这一空白：首先通过区分本体提取与逻辑翻译，为FOL自动形式化任务提供严谨定义，揭示两者混淆如何掩盖跨研究评估；系统回顾现有数据集、评估指标及基于LLM的方法（包括微调、提示工程、基于验证的精炼）；识别出基准测试、语义评估、本体感知方法以及端到端应用中的开放挑战。

summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in sociotechnical systems where social attribution, the reasoning process attributing external events to the causes and reasons of agents' social behaviors, plays a critical role. These processes involve judgments of social cause, responsibility, and blame/credit to agents. Although attributional models are well-studied in social psychology and cognition through Attribution Theory, social attribution remains underexplored in AI, particularly LLM social reasoning. This paper provides the first systematic exploration of LLM social attribution. Our work focuses on responsibility and blame attributions, examining current LLMs' judgments and their underlying internal mechanisms. Guided by attribution theory, we construct a social attribution benchmark consisting of a Vignette subset based on classic scenarios from attribution theory research and a Reality subset based on real-world social narratives, yielding 7,639 responsibility/blame judgment questions. On this basis, we evaluate 32 representative LLMs and 5 basic non-LLM baselines. To further explore the internal mechanisms underlying the LLM judgment process, we develop a probing-based methodology to investigate the latent-space representations of 5 key attribution dimensions and the consistency of their influences on LLM judgments compared to those in human social attribution. Our research findings reveal that current LLMs exhibit measurable but incomplete agreement with human responsibility and blame judgments, and meanwhile, this agreement is positively correlated with model size. Some attribution dimensions are systematically decodable from specific positions in LLM hidden states, and their influences on the final judgment are consistent with those indicated by human Attribution Theory. The dataset and associated code are available at https://github.com/Yuzhaoxin946/SAB-Bench.
title: Examining Social Attribution in LLM Reasoning: A Theory-Guided Probing Methodology
title_translated: 探究大语言模型推理中的社会归因：一种理论指导的探针方法
summary_translated: 大语言模型（LLMs）在社会技术系统中的应用日益广泛，其中社会归因——即把外部事件归因于代理社会行为的原因和动机——起着关键作用。这一过程涉及对社会因果、责任以及责备/褒奖的判断。尽管归因理论在社会心理学和认知科学中已有深入研究，但AI领域尤其是LLM的社会推理中，社会归因仍鲜有探索。本文首次系统性地探讨了LLM的社会归因问题。研究聚焦于责任与责备归因，考察当前LLMs的判断及其内在机制。基于归因理论，我们构建了一个社会归因基准测试，包含基于经典归因研究场景的短篇故事子集（Vignette）和基于真实社会叙事的现实子集（Reality），共生成7,639个责任/责备判断问题。在此基础上，评估了32个代表性LLMs和5个基础非LLM基线模型。为进一步探究LLM判断过程的内部机制，我们开发了一种基于探针的方法，研究5个关键归因维度在潜在空间中的表示，并比较其对LLM判断的影响与人类社会归因的一致性。研究发现，当前LLMs在责任与责备判断上表现出可测量但不完整的与人类的一致性，且这种一致性与模型规模呈正相关。部分归因维度可从LLM隐藏状态的特定位置系统性解码，其对最终判断的影响与人类归因理论所指示的一致。数据集及相关代码已公开于https://github.com/Yuzhaoxin946/SAB-Bench。

summary: Jev is a "System One" model that returns a choice among given options instead of generating text. We study how such a specialized decision model compares with general-purpose large language models (LLMs). We evaluate Jev on 13 multiple-choice benchmarks covering knowledge, reasoning, and multilingual understanding, and compare it with 19 LLMs in three tiers: frontier, representative, and small. Jev is competitive with frontier LLMs on knowledge and commonsense benchmarks and obtains the best score on MMLU-Redux and ARC-Challenge. Outside mathematics, it also outperforms most representative LLMs and all small LLMs. However, it falls behind on mathematical word problems: on MathQA, it is 17.7 points below the frontier median and scores lower than all 19 LLMs. These results indicate that a specialized decision model can match general-purpose LLMs on decisions that rely mainly on knowledge, but not on decisions that require multi-step calculation.
title: Specialized Decision Models vs. General-Purpose LLMs: Benchmarking Jev Across Knowledge, Reasoning, and Multilingual Tasks
title_translated: 专用决策模型与通用大语言模型的对比：Jev在知识、推理与多语言任务上的基准测试
summary_translated: Jev是一种“系统一”模型，它从给定选项中返回一个选择，而非生成文本。本文研究此类专用决策模型与通用大语言模型（LLMs）的性能对比。我们在涵盖知识、推理和多语言理解的13个多项选择基准上评估Jev，并与三个层级的19个LLMs（前沿、代表性、小型）进行比较。Jev在知识和常识基准上表现与前沿LLMs相当，在MMLU-Redux和ARC-Challenge上取得最佳成绩。在数学以外的任务中，其表现优于大多数代表性LLMs和所有小型LLMs。然而，在数学应用题方面表现落后：在MathQA上比前沿模型中位数低17.7分，且低于全部19个LLMs。结果表明，专用决策模型可在主要依赖知识的决策任务上媲美通用LLMs，但在需要多步计算的决策任务上则表现不足。

summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) is the central training paradigm for advancing large foundation models towards self-improvement. This report introduces the MiMo-V2.6 series, an omni-modal family that pushes the frontier of model intelligence by scaling RL compute. Prior to RL, we conduct mid-training on a broad multimodal corpus to provide ample exploration space, and build a solid infrastructure on the pretrained hybrid-SWA architecture to support subsequent scale-up. We scale RL compute along three dimensions: (1) larger batches and higher throughput, with an asynchronous training that consumes 1,568 samples and 2.7-3.7B tokens per step at context lengths of up to 1M; (2) more diverse and complex environments, spanning code, general, visual, and cyber domains under a mixture of agent harnesses; and (3) more grader compute, via groupwise agentic grading that yields more accurate reward signals for long-horizon tasks and steers the model towards shorter, more token-efficient solutions. To keep training stable at scale, we freeze the MoE router and establish a multi-layer defense against reward hacking. We further build infrastructure for mixed-task agentic RL, including a unified trajectory representation, high-concurrency multi-framework rollout, decoupled control and data planes, and training-inference consistency. We open-source the training dynamics, RL environments, and RL framework to facilitate reproduction and further research on scaled RL and model self-improvement.
title: MiMo-V2.6: Scaling Reinforcement Learning Towards Self-Improvement
title_translated: MiMo-V2.6：向自我提升迈进的强化学习规模化
summary_translated: 强化学习（RL）是推动大型基础模型实现自我提升的核心训练范式。本报告介绍了MiMo-V2.6系列，这是一个全模态家族，通过规模化RL计算推动模型智能的边界。在RL训练前，我们对广泛的多模态语料进行中期训练，以提供充足的探索空间，并在预训练的混合SWA架构上建立坚实基础设施，支持后续扩展。我们从三个维度扩大RL计算规模：（1）更大的批量和更高吞吐量，采用异步训练方式，每步处理最多1568个样本和2.7–3.7B个标记，上下文长度可达100万；（2）更丰富复杂的环境，涵盖代码、通用、视觉和网络领域，使用多种代理协同机制；（3）更强的评分计算能力，通过群体式智能体评分机制，为长周期任务提供更准确的奖励信号，并引导模型趋向更短、更高效的解决方案。为保障大规模训练的稳定性，我们冻结MoE路由模块，并建立多层防御机制以防止奖励劫持。此外，我们构建了混合任务智能体强化学习的基础设施，包括统一轨迹表示、高并发多框架回放、控制与数据平面解耦，以及训练-推理一致性。我们开源了训练动态、RL环境和RL框架，以促进规模化RL与模型自我提升的复现与进一步研究。

summary: Reliable multimodal interaction depends on selective use of conversational history: an earlier question may remain relevant while its previous answer is outdated, whereas a current request may depend on historical evidence despite conflicting new observations. Existing multi-turn evaluations rarely separate these history-use demands from underlying question difficulty. To address this gap, we introduce ReTurn, a benchmark of 7,000 base tasks spanning visual and audio evidence for evaluating selective history use. For task-carrying history, Reconfirm/Reground require applying a historical question to current media while varying historical agreement; for evidence-carrying history, Retrieve/Rebind require answering a current question using historical media while varying current-media competition. Each pair preserves the target question, media, and answer. Tasks support open-ended and multiple-choice evaluation, with matched single-turn counterparts serving as answerability references. Across 13 omni-modal, vision-language, and audio-language models, median model-level open-ended accuracy falls from 93.7% with direct input to 72.3% in conversation. Behavioral probes show that high question recall can coexist with weaker task application, while competing media can redirect answers away from historical targets. Supervised adaptation yields only partial gains. ReTurn provides a controlled framework for assessing whether multimodal models select and use the historical information required by each request.
title: When History Helps and Hurts: Selective History Use across Multimodal Turns
title_translated: 历史信息何时有益，何时有害：跨多模态回合的选择性历史使用
summary_translated: 可靠的多模态交互依赖于对对话历史的选择性使用：先前的问题可能仍相关，而其之前的回答已过时；当前请求可能依赖历史证据，即使存在与新观察相冲突的信息。现有回合式评估很少将历史使用需求与问题本身的难度区分开。为填补这一空白，我们提出了ReTurn，一个包含7,000个基础任务的基准测试，用于评估选择性历史使用能力。对于携带任务的历史，Reconfirm/Reground要求将历史问题应用于当前媒体，同时改变历史一致性；对于携带证据的历史，Retrieve/Rebind要求使用历史媒体回答当前问题，同时改变当前媒体的竞争性。每对任务保持目标问题、媒体和答案一致。任务支持开放式和多项选择评估，并配有单回合对应任务作为可答性参考。在13个全模态、视觉-语言和音频-语言模型上的实验显示，模型在开放问答中的中位准确率从直接输入的93.7%下降至对话情境下的72.3%。行为探针显示，高问题回忆能力可与较弱的任务应用共存，而竞争性媒体会引导答案偏离历史目标。监督微调仅带来部分提升。ReTurn提供了一个受控框架，用于评估多模态模型是否能根据每个请求选择并使用所需的历史信息。

summary: For persistent and personalized conversational agents, memory systems can enable them to remember, update, and reason over long histories by storing past interactions and retrieving relevant information. Existing memory systems typically follow two paradigms: flat-structured memory and graph-based memory. The former is lightweight but leaves event relations and state updates implicit, while the latter explicitly models memory structure but incurs additional construction cost and introduces irrelevant relations over long histories. To address these limitations, we propose QGMem, a novel memory construction and activation framework motivated by human memory, in which experience is organized into events and query-relevant events are modeled by graph as working memory. QGMem converts long dialogue histories into event-indexed atomic memory units that preserve individual experiences and consolidates related units into dynamic memory traces that retain state trajectories and current states. When a query arrives, hybrid memory retrieval gathers complementary candidate memories, and query-aware reranking activates the most relevant units as a compact working memory. To expose relational dependencies in the working memory and support conflict-aware reasoning, QGMem organizes the working memory as a local graph, which is then encoded as a graph token and provided to the LLM together with the textual working memory to improve evidence utilization during answer generation. Experiments across six benchmarks validate the framework and show consistent gains in retrieval, multi-hop evidence composition, conflict resolution, and ultra-long dialogue reasoning with compact contexts and moderate inference cost.
title: Event-Centric Memory with Query-Aware Graph Augmentation for Long-Term Conversational Agents
comment: 17 pages, 7 figures. Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence (TPAMI)
title_translated: 面向长期对话智能体的事件中心记忆与查询感知图增强
summary_translated: 对于持久化和个性化的对话智能体，记忆系统可通过存储过往互动并检索相关信息，实现对长期历史的记忆、更新与推理。现有记忆系统通常遵循两种范式：扁平结构记忆和基于图的记忆。前者轻量但隐含事件关系与状态更新，后者显式建模记忆结构但增加构建成本，并在长期历史中引入无关关系。为解决这些局限，我们提出QGMem，一种受人类记忆启发的新颖记忆构建与激活框架。该框架将经验组织为事件，通过图结构建模与查询相关的事件作为工作记忆。QGMem将长对话历史转化为事件索引的原子记忆单元，保留个体经验，并将相关单元合并为动态记忆轨迹，以保留状态演化路径和当前状态。当查询到达时，混合记忆检索收集互补候选记忆，查询感知重排序激活最相关单元作为紧凑的工作记忆。为揭示工作记忆中的关系依赖并支持冲突感知推理，QGMem将工作记忆组织为局部图，再将其编码为图标记，与文本工作记忆一同提供给LLM，以提升答案生成过程中的证据利用效率。在六个基准上的实验验证了该框架的有效性，结果显示在检索、多跳证据组合、冲突解决及超长对话推理方面均有持续提升，且在紧凑上下文和适度推理开销下实现高效运行。

summary: Machine unlearning in large language models aims to remove unwanted knowledge while preserving the model's remaining capabilities. Although existing methods use retention objectives or restrict where edits occur, achieving the desired forgetting level can still leave collateral changes that impair non-target behavior. Our recovery comparisons suggest that some of these changes can be reversed while preserving observed forgetting performance. In this work, we present Propose-Then-Project Unlearning (PTP-U), a framework that combines targeted forgetting with the recovery of non-target capabilities. PTP-U first applies local analytic edits to weaken target knowledge associations, then aligns non-target output distributions with those of the original model to recover capabilities while maintaining fixed forgetting constraints. Both stages serve a common goal: satisfying the forgetting requirements while preserving fluent generation and performance on non-target tasks. Across three benchmarks, PTP-U achieves the strongest forgetting-retention trade-off among evaluated methods, reaching 81.22%-91.03% forgetting while preserving 94.20% non-target utility on average. At matched forgetting, PTP-U consistently retains higher non-target utility.
title: Not Every Change Is Necessary: Recoverable Drift in Large Language Model Unlearning
title_translated: 并非所有变化都是必要的：大型语言模型遗忘中的可恢复漂移
summary_translated: 大型语言模型的机器遗忘旨在移除不需要的知识，同时保留模型的其他能力。尽管现有方法使用保留目标或限制修改位置，但达到期望的遗忘程度仍可能带来影响非目标行为的附带变化。我们的恢复对比表明，这些变化中的一些可以被逆转，同时保持已观察到的遗忘性能。本文提出了一种名为“先提议再投影遗忘”（PTP-U）的框架，该框架结合了针对性遗忘与非目标能力的恢复。PTP-U首先通过局部分析编辑削弱目标知识的关联，然后将非目标输出分布与原始模型对齐，以在维持固定遗忘约束的同时恢复能力。两个阶段共同服务于一个目标：满足遗忘要求的同时，保持流畅生成和非目标任务上的性能。在三个基准测试中，PTP-U在评估方法中实现了最强的遗忘-保留权衡，平均遗忘率达到81.22%-91.03%，同时保留了94.20%的非目标效用。在相同遗忘水平下，PTP-U始终能保留更高的非目标效用。

summary: Stance detection requires identifying an author's attitude toward a given target, sometimes based on conversational context. Jev, a specialized decision model designed for structured decision-making, offers an alternative to general-purpose large language models (LLMs). In this work, we evaluate Jev on two stance detection datasets, VAST (English texts) and ZS-CSD (Chinese conversations), comparing it with four general-purpose LLMs and two fine-tuned models. Results show that Jev achieves competitive performance on VAST, matching GPT-5.6 and outperforming the other general-purpose LLMs. However, it falls behind stronger LLMs on ZS-CSD, particularly in distinguishing favor from against. Further analysis suggests that this limitation may be related to understanding reply relationships and stance direction rather than conversation length alone. These findings highlight both the potential and limitations of Jev for stance detection.
title: Can Decision Models Understand Stance? Evaluating Jev Against General-Purpose LLMs
title_translated: 决策模型能理解立场吗？对Jev与通用大语言模型的评估
summary_translated: 立场检测需要识别作者对特定目标的态度，有时基于对话上下文。Jev是一种专为结构化决策设计的专用决策模型，可作为通用大语言模型（LLMs）的替代方案。本文在两个立场检测数据集（VAST，英文文本；ZS-CSD，中文对话）上评估Jev的表现，并与四种通用大语言模型及两个微调模型进行比较。结果显示，Jev在VAST上表现具有竞争力，与GPT-5.6相当，优于其他通用大语言模型。然而，在ZS-CSD上，其表现落后于更强的大语言模型，尤其是在区分支持与反对立场方面。进一步分析表明，这一局限性可能与理解回复关系和立场方向有关，而非仅由对话长度决定。这些发现突显了Jev在立场检测中的潜力与局限性。

summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly embedded as components in software systems, marketed under labels such as chatbot, copilot, retrieval-augmented generation, workflow, coding agent and AI agent. Whether these labels denote genuine architectural forms or serve as branding has not been assessed systematically.   In the sources surveyed, labels do carry architectural content, most clearly in vendor usage: copilot denotes a router-worker architecture operating a host application under step-by-step user confirmation, while the more recent shift to the label agent coincides with AI-planned multi-step execution of which the user sees only the outcome. The coding agents of four major providers share one architecture, a reason-and-act loop delegating to subagents.   This survey describes seven recurring forms---LLM chats, custom agents, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), AI-enhanced workflows, copilots, coding agents, and, in part, agentic RAG---in a common vocabulary of agents and tools. Each is characterized along four structural dimensions (agentic RAG only partially): the architectural pattern, the control of execution and the point of user intervention, the number of agent calls per task, and tool use. An illustrative corpus of 22 systems from research publications and vendor documentation grounds the descriptions and shows where they reach their limit.
title: Forms of LLM-Integrated Applications from LLM-Chats to Autonomous AI Agent System
title_translated: 从LLM聊天到自主AI智能体系统的LLM集成应用形式
summary_translated: 大型语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地作为组件嵌入软件系统中，被标记为聊天机器人、协作者、检索增强生成、工作流、编程代理和AI代理等。这些标签是否代表真正的架构形态，还是仅作为品牌宣传，尚未得到系统评估。在调研的资料中，这些标签确实承载了架构内涵，尤其体现在厂商使用中：‘协作者’指代一种路由器-工作者架构，在用户逐步确认下操作宿主应用；而近年来转向‘代理’标签，则与用户仅看到结果的AI规划多步执行相一致。四大主要提供商的编程代理共享同一架构——一个推理-行动循环，委托给子代理。本调查描述了七种常见形式——LLM聊天、定制代理、检索增强生成（RAG）、AI增强工作流、协作者、编程代理以及部分的代理式RAG——并采用统一的智能体与工具词汇进行描述。每种形式均从四个结构维度进行刻画（代理式RAG仅部分）：架构模式、执行控制与用户干预点、每项任务的代理调用次数以及工具使用情况。一个包含22个系统的示例语料库来自研究论文和厂商文档，支撑描述并揭示其适用边界。

summary: Spin in clinical trials includes reporting practices that distort the presentation of results. This is particularly critical in medicine, where spin is present in more than 50% of randomized controlled trials that fail to reach statistical significance. The comparison of primary and reported outcomes is crucial for detecting several types of spin, including outcome switching. We used 300 pairs of outcomes labeled with semantic similarity to develop a system for automatic detection of outcome switching. We evaluated baseline text similarity models and open-source LLMs using generated similarity scores and the Youden index to determine the classification threshold. The proposed approach involves prompt engineering, classification based on token probabilities, and majority voting for the final decision. The results on the test set of 2,496 examples with an F1 score of 0.78 and an accuracy of 0.90 outperform baseline text similarity models but trail behind fine-tuned versions of BERT. We used LLMs to generate natural language explanations for the classified instances and manually assessed their quality.
title: Detecting Spin in Clinical Trials with Large Language Models
comment: 5 pages, 1 figure, 2 tables. Accepted at the 29th International Multiconference Information Society (IS 2026), AI in Healthcare track, Ljubljana, Slovenia. Code: this https URL
title_translated: 利用大型语言模型检测临床试验中的偏倚报告
summary_translated: 临床试验中的偏倚报告包括扭曲结果呈现的报告实践。这在医学领域尤为关键，超过50%的未达统计显著性的随机对照试验存在偏倚。比较主要结果与报告结果对于检测多种类型的偏倚（如结果变更）至关重要。我们使用300对带有语义相似性标注的结果对，开发了一个自动检测结果变更的系统。我们评估了基线文本相似性模型和开源大语言模型，使用生成的相似度分数和Youden指数确定分类阈值。所提出的方案包括提示工程、基于token概率的分类以及最终决策的多数投票机制。在包含2,496个样本的测试集上，F1得分为0.78，准确率为0.90，优于基线文本相似性模型，但仍逊于微调后的BERT版本。我们还利用大语言模型为分类实例生成自然语言解释，并人工评估其质量。

summary: Byte-level language models such as the Byte Latent Transformer (BLT) group bytes into patches and run their large global model once per patch. BLT starts a patch where a small model's next-byte entropy is high, so global compute goes where the next byte is hard to predict. We show that this rule has a systematic blind spot: positions whose type is predictable but whose value must be computed, such as the number after "=" in a worked math solution. Under tight patch budgets, entropy-triggered layouts skip these positions, and accuracy on them collapses. In Meta's BLT-1B with patch starts on 10% of bytes, the entropy rule puts a patch start at 16% of the computed results in GSM8K solutions and gets 19.0% of them exactly right; a boundary after each "=" at the same patch count gets 51.8%, and entropy combined with a label-free boundary-dependence signal gets 67.1% (default layout at 26% of bytes: 76.8%). The gap survives adapting BLT-1B to the budget with low-rank fine-tuning (32.9% vs 72.7%, three runs per rule, paired p < 1e-200) and grows with model size in byte models trained from scratch at a 10% budget: at 1M, 12M and 50M parameters, boundary dependence beats entropy on final answers by -1.6, +10.1 and +19.8 points, and at 50M it gets 35.9% of computed results against 13.9% (3 seeds each). BLT's entropy-jump rule helps neither target at 50M. The entropy trigger of Scratchpad Patching is likewise indistinguishable from random scratchpads on final answers (5.6% vs 5.9%, 5 seeds), while answer-start scratchpads give 38.1%. The effect is specific to computed values: copies and lookups gain little, and values the model cannot compute gain nothing. Boundary dependence, the rise in the model's own loss when a patch start is removed, measured per two-byte context, finds these positions without labels: combined with entropy it beats the hand-written rule on computed results.
title: Easy to anticipate, hard to compute: boundary dependence finds the computed outputs that entropy patching misses
comment: 13 pages, 4 figures, 6 tables. Code, logs and results: this https URL (archived: doi: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23238215 )
title_translated: 易于预测，难以计算：边界依赖性揭示熵修补遗漏的计算输出
summary_translated: 字节级语言模型（如字节潜在变换器BLT）将字节分组为块，并对每个块运行一次大型全局模型。BLT在小模型下一个字节的熵较高处启动块，使全局计算集中在下一个字节难以预测的位置。我们发现该规则存在系统性盲点：某些类型可预测但值必须计算的位置，例如数学解答中“=”后的数字。在严格的块预算下，基于熵触发的布局会跳过这些位置，导致其准确率崩溃。在Meta的BLT-1B中，当块起点设置在10%的字节上时，熵规则在GSM8K解答中仅在16%的计算结果处设置块起点，且仅有19.0%的解答完全正确；而在每个“=”后设置块起点（相同块数），正确率提升至51.8%；若结合无标签的边界依赖信号，正确率进一步提高至67.1%（默认布局在26%字节处：76.8%）。该差距在通过低秩微调适应预算后依然存在（32.9% vs 72.7%，三轮实验，配对p < 1e-200），且随模型规模增大而扩大：在从头训练的字节模型中，1M、12M和50M参数量下，边界依赖性在最终答案上分别领先熵规则-1.6、+10.1和+19.8分；在50M参数时，边界依赖性获得35.9%的计算结果正确率，而熵规则仅为13.9%（各3个种子）。在50M参数下，熵触发规则对两类目标均无帮助。类似地，Scratchpad Patching的熵触发规则在最终答案上与随机块无差异（5.6% vs 5.9%，5个种子），而答案起始块则达到38.1%。该效应特异于计算值：复制和查找收益甚微，模型无法计算的值则毫无收益。边界依赖性（即移除块起点时模型自身损失的上升，按两字节上下文测量）无需标签即可定位这些位置；结合熵规则后，其在计算结果上的表现优于手工编写规则。

summary: Multimodal depression assessment offers a promising approach to analyzing behavioral patterns associated with depression. However, existing methods often rely on dense and opaque multimodal representations, making it difficult to interpret the behavioral patterns underlying their predictions. In this work, we introduce BehavDep, a sparse factor-based framework that decomposes multimodal behavioral representations into sparse latent factors and associates them with behaviorally meaningful concepts through a semantic bridge. To address the mismatch between user-level annotations and heterogeneous video-level behaviors, BehavDep further learns video-level depression tendency scores under weak supervision and aggregates information across multiple observations for user-level assessment. Extensive experiments demonstrate that BehavDep achieves the best overall assessment performance while revealing complementary modality contributions, heterogeneous behavioral patterns across observations, and prediction responses to concept-level editing. These results show that BehavDep provides a structured and interpretable approach to analyzing multimodal behavioral representations for depression assessment.
title: From Sparse Representations to Behavioral Insights for Multimodal Depression Assessment
title_translated: 从稀疏表示到行为洞察：多模态抑郁症评估
summary_translated: 多模态抑郁症评估为分析与抑郁症相关的行为模式提供了一种有前景的方法。然而，现有方法通常依赖于密集且不透明的多模态表示，难以解释其预测背后的行为模式。本文提出BehavDep，一种基于稀疏因子的框架，将多模态行为表示分解为稀疏潜在因子，并通过语义桥梁将其与具有行为意义的概念关联起来。为解决用户级标注与异构视频级行为之间的不匹配问题，BehavDep在弱监督下学习视频级抑郁倾向评分，并聚合多个观察结果以进行用户级评估。大量实验表明，BehavDep在整体评估性能上表现最佳，同时揭示了互补的模态贡献、跨观察的异构行为模式以及对概念级编辑的预测响应。这些结果表明，BehavDep为抑郁症评估中的多模态行为表示分析提供了一种结构化且可解释的方法。

summary: Long-term personalization requires language models to use interaction history to track users' preferences across sessions. Parametric memory encodes this interaction history into model parameters or adapters, reducing the need to include it in the inference context. However, independent context compilation leaves cross-session integration unspecified, while recurrent updates can attenuate earlier evidence. To address these challenges, we propose Dual-Path Parametric Memory (DPPM). Its Evidence path directly pools representations of the interaction history to preserve earlier evidence, while its Delta path sequentially updates an associative state to capture changes. Fusing both outputs produces history-conditioned LoRA adapters that combine evidence accumulation with ordered revision. Across multiple backbones, DPPM outperforms the evaluated baselines, achieving 54.22% on PersonaMem-v2 and 86.79% on PrefEval. These results suggest that DPPM provides a simple and effective design choice for cross-session personalized parametric memory.
title: DPPM: Dual-Path Parametric Memory for Personalized Language Models
title_translated: DPPM：个性化语言模型的双路径参数化记忆
summary_translated: 长期个性化需要语言模型利用交互历史来跟踪用户在不同会话中的偏好。参数化记忆将此交互历史编码为模型参数或适配器，从而减少在推理上下文中包含该历史的需求。然而，独立的上下文编译使得跨会话整合不明确，而递归更新可能削弱早期证据。为解决这些问题，我们提出了双路径参数化记忆（DPPM）。其证据路径直接汇集交互历史的表示以保留早期证据，而其增量路径则顺序更新一个关联状态以捕捉变化。融合两者输出生成了结合证据积累与有序修订的历史条件LoRA适配器。在多个骨干模型上，DPPM均优于所评估基线，在PersonaMem-v2上达到54.22%，在PrefEval上达到86.79%。这些结果表明，DPPM为跨会话个性化参数化记忆提供了一个简单而有效的设计选择。

summary: Safety evaluations of large language models commonly summarize harmful-output behavior with attack success rate (ASR). Yet the same non-harmful outcome can arise for very different reasons. A model may recover a harmful task and refuse it, fail to recover the task, or respond to something else entirely. Distinguishing these cases becomes especially important under intent-obscuring prompts, where a low ASR does not reveal whether the evaluated task was actually engaged. To make this distinction explicit, we pair ASR with operative understanding rate (UR), which measures whether a response both identifies the evaluated task and treats it as the task to be answered. Across interfaces, this paired view reveals substantial variation hidden by ASR: similar ASR values can correspond to sharply different recovery rates. Controlled English reconstructions show that recovery consistently improves as compressed prompts become more explicit, whereas ASR does not follow the same pattern. A complementary contrast comes from FormalLogic, where high recovery can still coincide with frequent harmful assistance. Together, these results show that non-harmful outcomes are not equally informative about model safety, motivating the joint reporting of intent recovery and ASR in LLM safety evaluation. Code and experiment inputs are available at https://github.com/kevinjiang0121-cyber/IRIS.
title: Same Outcome, Different Evidence: Intent Recovery in LLM Safety Evaluation

title_translated: 相同结果，不同依据：大语言模型安全评估中的意图恢复
summary_translated: 大语言模型的安全评估通常使用攻击成功率（ASR）来总结有害输出行为。然而，相同的非有害结果可能源于截然不同的原因。模型可能恢复了有害任务并拒绝执行，未能恢复该任务，或完全回应其他内容。在意图模糊提示下，这种区分尤为重要，因为低ASR并不能说明实际是否参与了评估任务。为明确区分，我们引入操作理解率（UR），衡量响应是否既识别出评估任务，又将其视为需回答的任务。在多种接口中，这一组合视角揭示了ASR所掩盖的显著差异：相似的ASR值可能对应截然不同的恢复率。受控英语重构显示，随着压缩提示变得越来越明确，恢复能力持续提升，而ASR并未呈现相同趋势。另一对比来自FormalLogic，高恢复率仍可能伴随频繁的有害协助。这些结果表明，非有害结果并非同等反映模型安全性，因此应在大语言模型安全评估中联合报告意图恢复率与ASR。代码和实验输入见https://github.com/kevinjiang0121-cyber/IRIS。

summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly ship with explicit "thinking modes", yet their counterpart, "no-thinking", has received far less attention. We study LLMs' no-thinking behavior along two axes. a. How to measure no-thinking? Prior work typically defines no-thinking through proxies such as a disabled thinking mode or the absence of long traces. These proxies are unreliable: disabled thinking modes may still emit reasoning, while long traces may contain filler rather than genuine inference. We instead normalize each response into a pre-answer trace and final answer, and evaluate it at three levels: (i) Empty-Thinking Rate for strict answer-only compliance; (ii) instruction-aware Question-Pre-answer Relevance for similarity between the question and pre-answer trace; and (iii) LLM-as-judge Explicit Inference Rate for visible explicit inference. Together, these metrics distinguish answer-only output, relevant but non-inferential text, and explicit inference. b. How does no-thinking vary across tasks and models? We evaluate six prompting interventions on six LLMs across Boolean, multiple-choice, and open-ended questions. We find that explicit no-think controls cannot reliably eliminate visible inference. Models instead exhibit "Thinking Inertia": explicit inference persists even under strict controls and becomes more prevalent as the answer space opens. Accuracy remains stable on Boolean and multiple-choice tasks, whereas open-ended tasks reveal a trade-off between answer-only compliance and task accuracy. Rewriting the same questions across answer spaces shows that supplying candidate answers makes answer-only responses easier to produce. These findings establish no-thinking as a non-trivial capability: stopping explicit reasoning cannot be assumed from model settings or instructions alone and deserves systematic evaluation alongside reasoning ability.
title: Thinking Inertia: LLMs Keep Thinking When Told Not To

title_translated: 思维惯性：当被要求停止思考时，大语言模型仍继续思考
summary_translated: 大型语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地配备显式的“思考模式”，但其反面——“无思考”模式却受到较少关注。我们沿着两个维度研究LLMs的无思考行为。a. 如何衡量无思考？以往工作通常通过禁用思考模式或缺乏长推理轨迹等代理指标定义无思考。这些代理不可靠：禁用思考模式仍可能产生推理，而长轨迹可能仅含填充内容而非真实推理。我们改而将每个响应归一化为预答案轨迹和最终答案，并在三个层面进行评估：(i) 空思考率，用于严格遵守仅输出答案；(ii) 指令感知的问题-预答案相关性，衡量问题与预答案轨迹之间的相似性；(iii) LLM作为裁判的显式推理率，检测可见的显式推理。这三个指标可区分仅输出答案、相关但非推理性文本以及显式推理。b. 无思考行为在不同任务和模型间如何变化？我们在六种LLM上对六种提示干预在布尔题、选择题和开放题上进行了评估。发现显式无思考控制无法可靠消除可见推理。模型表现出“思维惯性”：即使在严格控制下，显式推理仍持续存在，且随着答案空间扩大而更加普遍。在布尔题和选择题上准确率保持稳定，而开放题揭示了仅输出答案与任务准确率之间的权衡。在同一问题在不同答案空间下的重写实验表明，提供候选答案使仅输出答案更易实现。这些发现确立了无思考是一种非平凡的能力：不能仅从模型设置或指令中假设停止显式推理，而应与推理能力一起进行系统评估。

summary: This study addresses the problem of structured sentiment analysis, whose goal is to obtain a fine-grained sentiment graph where the nodes represent spans of sentiment holders, targets, and expressions, while the arcs define the relationships among them. Our proposed approach casts the task as dependency graph parsing, but departs from traditional parsing methods by solving it through sequence labeling. To do so, we leverage recent advances in linearized graph encodings that allow each word in the input to be assigned a label, effectively capturing the structure of the dependency graph. We conducted experiments on seven datasets spanning five languages (English, Spanish, Norwegian, Basque, and Catalan), showing performance competitive with leading, more complex single-model approaches.
title: Structured Sentiment Analysis Using Sequence Labeling as Dependency Graph Parsing
title_translated: 使用序列标注作为依存图解析的结构化情感分析
summary_translated: 本研究针对结构化情感分析问题，其目标是获得一个细粒度的情感图，其中节点代表情感持有者、目标和表达词段，边则定义它们之间的关系。我们提出的方法将该任务建模为依存图解析，但不同于传统解析方法，通过序列标注来解决。为此，我们利用最近在图线性化编码方面的进展，使输入中的每个词都能被赋予一个标签，从而有效捕捉依存图的结构。我们在涵盖五种语言（英语、西班牙语、挪威语、巴斯克语和加泰罗尼亚语）的七个数据集上进行了实验，性能与更复杂、领先的单模型方法相当。

summary: Verifier scores now serve as both benchmark metrics and training rewards for large language model (LLM) agents, and a change in score is routinely read as a change in capability. It may instead reflect a change in the evaluation. We introduce TRACE, a protocol that turns a score change from a verdict into a testable diagnosis: it applies a targeted change to one part of an evaluation, compares paired runs, checks whether the agent's behavior changed, and rescores unchanged trajectories to test whether the scoring rule is responsible. In a controlled suite of 25 synthetic tasks, renaming tools lowers a scripted agent's score by 0.250 even though it performs exactly the same operations; restoring the original names at scoring time closes the entire gap, while the same mutation exposes a genuine behavioral failure in a second agent. On public $τ^2$-bench tasks with four LLM agents, an initial 30-task study finds mixed reward changes whose one clear effect does not replicate. In a larger follow-up on 88 new tasks with repeated runs per condition, renaming tools or reformatting tool outputs leaves reward unchanged to within $\pm$0.10 for seven of eight agent-change pairs, whereas tool names that deliberately mislead lower every agent's reward by 0.20-0.44, showing that the setup can detect real effects. Identical reruns flip 15-36% of task outcomes, so single-run comparisons cannot separate presentation effects from run-to-run variation. Two frontier LLM judges give consistent verdicts when a fixed trajectory is presented differently, yet disagree with each other on 57% of the same records, largely because one grades procedure rather than outcome. TRACE thus separates what a score change says about the agent from what it says about the measurement.
title: TRACE: Diagnosing Verifier Brittleness in Agentic Evaluation
title_translated: TRACE：诊断智能体评估中验证器的脆弱性
summary_translated: 验证器得分现在既作为大型语言模型（LLM）智能体的基准指标，也作为训练奖励，分数的变化通常被解读为能力的变化。但实际上，这可能反映的是评估方式的改变。我们提出了TRACE协议，将分数变化从结论转化为可测试的诊断：对评估的某一部分进行有针对性的修改，比较成对运行结果，检查智能体行为是否发生变化，并重新评分未改变的轨迹，以检验评分规则是否负责。在25个合成任务的受控实验中，重命名工具使脚本化智能体的得分下降0.250，尽管其执行操作完全相同；在评分时恢复原始名称则完全弥补了这一差距，而同一变异在第二个智能体上暴露了真实的行為失败。在包含四个LLM智能体的公开τ²-bench任务中，初步30项任务研究发现奖励变化不一致，其中唯一明确的效果无法复现。在更大规模的后续研究中，针对88个新任务进行重复运行，重命名工具或重新格式化工具输出对七组八种智能体-变更组合的奖励影响均在±0.10范围内，而故意误导的工具名称使所有智能体的奖励降低0.20-0.44，表明该设置能够检测真实效应。相同的重运行导致15%-36%的任务结果翻转，因此单次运行比较无法区分呈现效果与运行间差异。两名前沿LLM评判者在固定轨迹不同呈现下给出一致判断，但在相同记录上彼此分歧率达57%，主要因为一人依据流程而非结果打分。TRACE因此将分数变化所反映的智能体特性与测量本身的问题区分开来。

summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) supervises student-generated trajectories with token-level teacher signals. Its sampled-token variant avoids the cost of full-vocabulary probabilities. Yet we find that training on fewer tokens can outperform full-token OPD, challenging the intuition that more supervision improves learning. This motivates selecting tokens by learning value. Existing disagreement-based criteria ignore probability scale: tokens assigned negligible probability by both models, termed low-low tokens, can receive large log-ratio rewards and hinder learning. We propose DIAL-OPD, a token-selection method that bridges log-probability and probability spaces by weighting reward magnitude with the logarithmic mean of teacher and student probabilities. A parameter beta controls this weighting, and the highest-scoring tokens are retained. Across 4 teacher-student pairs and 7 mathematical reasoning benchmarks, we compare DIAL-OPD with 9 baselines. Retaining only 40% of tokens, it outperforms Vanilla OPD and its full-token variants, with mean accuracy gains reaching 5.25 percentage points over Vanilla OPD, and doubles AIME25 Pass@16 from 13.33% to 26.67%. It also achieves up to an 18% relative improvement in mean accuracy over the strongest token-selection baseline at matched retention ratios. With a 4B teacher, DIAL-OPD surpasses the strongest full-token baseline using an 8B teacher at both student scales, showing that effective supervision allocation can outweigh teacher scaling. Further analysis shows that moderate beta balances suppressing low-low tokens against preserving useful disagreements. Token-level evidence reveals that DIAL-OPD filters high-reward tokens with limited reasoning value while preserving supervision critical to reasoning correctness.
title: DIAL-OPD: Learning More from Fewer Tokens in On-Policy Distillation
title_translated: DIAL-OPD：在策略蒸馏中用更少的token学习更多
summary_translated: 在策略蒸馏（OPD）中，教师模型通过逐token信号监督学生生成的轨迹。其采样token变体避免了全词汇概率计算的成本。然而我们发现，使用更少的token进行训练反而优于完整token的OPD，挑战了‘更多监督提升学习’的直觉。这促使我们通过学习价值来选择token。现有基于分歧的准则忽略了概率尺度：两个模型都赋予极低概率的token（称为low-low token）可能获得较大的对数比奖励，从而阻碍学习。我们提出DIAL-OPD，一种通过将奖励幅度与教师和学生概率的对数平均值加权来连接对数概率与概率空间的token选择方法。参数beta控制此加权，保留得分最高的token。在4对教师-学生模型和7个数学推理基准上，我们将DIAL-OPD与9个基线进行比较。仅保留40%的token，其性能就超过普通OPD及其全token版本，平均准确率相比普通OPD提升5.25个百分点，AIME25 Pass@16从13.33%提升至26.67%。在匹配保留率下，相比最强的token选择基线，其平均准确率相对提升高达18%。使用4B教师模型的DIAL-OPD，在学生规模相同时超越了使用8B教师的最强全token基线，表明有效的监督分配可以超越教师规模的提升。进一步分析显示，适度的beta值能在抑制low-low token与保留有用分歧之间取得平衡。token级证据表明，DIAL-OPD过滤了高奖励但推理价值有限的token，同时保留了对推理正确性至关重要的监督信号。

summary: German is a morphologically rich language whose syllable structure is exceptionally well-predicted by the Knuth--Liang hyphenation algorithm. We ask whether phonologically informed tokenization can serve as a competitive target for end-to-end speech recognition. We compare three tokenizer families on the Omnilingual ASR wav2vec 2.0 backbone fine-tuned with CTC: the pretrained multilingual character inventory, a data-driven Byte-Pair Encoding (BPE) over orthography, and phonologically informed units from Pyphen syllabification and grapheme-to-phoneme conversion. Across 40 fine-tunes, we evaluate on three German test sets spanning orthogonal shifts: in-domain read speech, dialectal spontaneous speech, and standard-German spontaneous speech. In-domain, all phonologically informed tokenizers match BPE and the multilingual character baseline on both WER and CER. Under domain shift the picture splits along vocabulary size rather than the linguistic axis of variation: at small vocabularies, syllable-aware tokenization improves on dialectal speech, where phonetic surface forms vary but syllable structure is preserved, and stays ahead on spontaneous speech, where new word-forms violate vocabulary closure. A phoneme-level confusion analysis further shows that all tokenizers commit the same canonical function-word errors, indicating that the acoustic encoder, not the tokenizer, dominates the error topology. Our findings suggest that tokenizer choice may depend on the vocabulary budget as much as on the distribution shift expected at deployment rather than reducing to a single universal optimum.
title: Phonologically Informed Tokenization for German Speech Recognition: A Cross-Domain Study
title_translated: 基于语音学信息的德语语音识别分词：一项跨领域研究
summary_translated: 德语是一种形态丰富的语言，其音节结构可通过Knuth-Liang连字符算法高度预测。我们探讨语音学信息分词能否成为端到端语音识别的有力目标。我们在Omnilingual ASR wav2vec 2.0骨干网络上，使用CTC进行微调，对比三种分词器家族：预训练的多语言字符库、基于正字法的数据驱动Byte-Pair Encoding（BPE），以及来自Pyphen音节划分和音素到音位转换的语音学信息单元。在40次微调中，我们在三个德语测试集上进行评估，涵盖正交变化：领域内朗读语音、方言自发语音和标准德语自发语音。在领域内，所有语音学信息分词器在WER和CER上均与BPE及多语言字符基线相当。在领域迁移下，表现差异由词汇量大小决定，而非语言学变化轴：小词汇量下，音节感知分词在方言语音中表现更优（语音表面形式变化但音节结构保持），在自发语音中也持续领先（新词形破坏词汇闭包）。音素级混淆分析进一步表明，所有分词器犯下相同的典型功能词错误，说明错误拓扑主要由声学编码器决定，而非分词器。研究结果表明，分词器的选择可能取决于部署时预期的词汇预算与分布偏移，而非单一普适最优方案。

summary: Evaluating user experience (UX) with automated computational methods has gained increasing attention, supported by empirical evidence from UXBench. However, binary preference prediction provides limited insight, while relying on a single user-agnostic reward model overlooks the inherent heterogeneity of users, whose expectations can differ substantially. In this paper, we present UXBench Pro, comprising 1{,}000 test instances derived from real user interactions across 12 task scenarios and 82 domains. Each instance is paired with a FACTORS user profile that characterizes the user through seven interpretable behavioral facets, differentiating user groups. To provide richer evaluation insights, we introduce a dual-perspective paradigm that combines a personalized User Reward Model (URM) for third-person judgment with Sim4Eval, a user simulator that enables multi-turn interactions and provides first-person evaluation across four cognitive state dimensions. To assess the reliability of these based evaluators, we further introduce two meta-benchmarks, URMBench and USimBench, that evaluate how faithfully they reproduce real human preferences and behaviors. Extensive experiments reveal seven key findings that highlight the importance of user modeling and multi-perspective evaluation, offering a fresh perspective on user-centric benchmarking and motivating personalized model optimization.
title: UXBench Pro: Benchmarking Personalized User Experience in Multi-Turn Dialogue Interactions
title_translated: UXBench Pro：多轮对话交互中个性化用户体验的基准测试
summary_translated: 使用自动化计算方法评估用户体验（UX）已受到越来越多关注，这得到了UXBench实证证据的支持。然而，二元偏好预测提供的信息有限，而依赖单一用户无关奖励模型则忽视了用户的内在异质性，其期望可能显著不同。本文提出UXBench Pro，包含从12个任务场景和82个领域的真实用户交互中提取的1,000个测试实例。每个实例配有一个FACTORS用户画像，通过七个可解释的行为维度刻画用户特征，用于区分用户群体。为提供更丰富的评估洞察，我们引入双视角范式：结合个性化用户奖励模型（URM）进行第三人称判断，以及Sim4Eval用户模拟器，支持多轮交互并从四个认知状态维度提供第一人称评估。为评估这些评估器的可靠性，我们进一步引入两个元基准——URMBench和USimBench，用于评估它们再现真实人类偏好与行为的忠实度。大量实验揭示七个关键发现，强调了用户建模与多视角评估的重要性，为以用户为中心的基准测试提供了新视角，并推动个性化模型优化。

summary: Journals and conferences have begun to screen submitted manuscripts for text written using large language models (LLMs). The reliability of this screening rests on benchmark evaluations against a fixed set of LLM versions, while the versions in actual use keep changing. Here we quantify how this LLM turnover affects the screening of scientific manuscripts. We paired 4,000 pre-ChatGPT abstracts from the Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences with their rewrites by 23 LLM versions from three vendors, released between June 2023 and August 2026. We then trained detectors under maintenance scenarios ranging from a detector retrained on every new version to one trained once and never updated. Detectors trained only on a vendor's past versions can collapse at the boundaries between model generations: calibrated to falsely flag 1% of human-written abstracts, they catch above 99% of rewrites just before the sharpest boundary and 3.8% just after it. Detectors trained on later versions can also miss rewrites of earlier ones. Vocabulary differences between versions largely track where detection transfers and where it fails. In the two screening scenarios we simulated, screens covering all 23 versions either flagged one in eight human-written abstracts or missed one in three rewrites of the newest version. Indeed, a commercial detector missed most rewrites of the version just after the sharpest boundary while flagging almost no human-written abstracts. Research-integrity policy should therefore treat the benchmark accuracy of a detector as provisional, to be re-verified with every LLM release, including earlier versions.
title: Large Language Model Turnover Undermines Screening for Artificial Intelligence-Assisted Scientific Writing
title_translated: 大型语言模型迭代削弱了人工智能辅助科学写作的筛选可靠性
summary_translated: 期刊和会议已开始对提交稿件中使用大型语言模型（LLM）撰写的文本进行筛查。这种筛查的可靠性依赖于对固定LLM版本的基准评估，但实际使用的版本却持续更新。本文量化了LLM版本迭代如何影响科学论文的筛查效果。我们将4,000篇ChatGPT之前的《美国国家科学院院刊》摘要与23个来自三家供应商、发布于2023年6月至2026年8月间的LLM版本重写文本配对，并训练检测器应对从每次新版本后重新训练到仅一次训练且永不更新的不同维护场景。仅基于供应商历史版本训练的检测器在模型代际边界处会崩溃：校准为误报1%的人类撰写摘要，可在最尖锐边界前捕获超过99%的重写文本，而在边界后仅捕获3.8%。基于后期版本训练的检测器也可能漏掉早期版本的重写内容。版本间的词汇差异基本对应于检测迁移成功与失败的位置。在我们模拟的两种筛查场景中，覆盖全部23个版本的筛查要么误标八分之一的人类摘要，要么漏掉三分之一最新版本的重写。事实上，一款商用检测器在最尖锐边界后的版本重写中几乎全部漏检，而几乎未标记任何人类摘要。因此，研究诚信政策应将检测器的基准准确性视为临时性，需在每次LLM发布（包括旧版本）后重新验证。

summary: Current frontier LLMs can theoretically process long contexts with 1M tokens or more. But to what extent can they go beyond simple retrieval and perform deeper reasoning over such long contexts? We empirically investigate long-horizon reasoning capabilities of LLMs, focusing on deductive logic expressed in Prolog. We construct ProloNg, a synthetic testbed to probe Prolog Long Reasoning, which systematically varies the complexity (reasoning depth) of problems, where the hardest case has a reasoning depth of 22 and 62k context length. We study 8 reasoning models across 5 families of frontier LLMs, and find that performance degrades substantially as reasoning depth grows, with the majority of models approaching chance beyond depth 10.
title: Probing for Long-Horizon Deductive Reasoning Capabilities in Language Models with Prolog
title_translated: 使用Prolog探测语言模型的长时程演绎推理能力
summary_translated: 当前前沿的大规模语言模型理论上可以处理长达100万token或更多的上下文。但它们在如此长的上下文中能走多远，超越简单的检索并进行更深层次的推理？我们通过实证研究了大规模语言模型的长时程推理能力，重点关注以Prolog表达的演绎逻辑。我们构建了ProloNg，一个合成测试平台，用于探测Prolog长推理，系统性地变化问题的复杂度（推理深度），其中最困难的情况推理深度达到22，上下文长度为62k。我们研究了来自5个前沿大模型家族的8种推理模型，发现随着推理深度增加，性能显著下降，大多数模型在推理深度超过10后接近随机水平。

summary: Existing evaluation methods for healthcare LLMs primarily assess factual correctness,safety, and fluency, while providing limited insight into whether generated interactions reflect culturally situated healthcare reasoning. This limitation is particularly important in maternal health, where care decisions are shaped by social and relational norms. We introduce MH-INDIC, a culturally grounded evaluation framework for maternal-health interactions in urban and semi-urban North Indian contexts that operationalises cultural behaviour through ten dimensions of maternal-health reasoning. Using a 26-item survey administered to 102 pregnant and postpartum women from urban and semi-urban North India, we evaluate ten LLMs. We distinguish population level cultural alignment from profile-level behavioural variation. Although several models approximate the human population-level distribution, all evaluated systems exhibit substantially lower variation across demographic and household profiles than the human cohort, revealing a gap between aggregate alignment and profile-conditioned sensitivity. As a downstream application of MH-INDIC, we use the strongest-aligned proprietary and open-source models to generate culturally conditioned maternal-health dialogues under zero-shot, self-conditioned, and human-grounded prompting. Human-grounded conditioning produces stronger profile alignment and dialogue quality ratings, suggesting that measured cultural profiles can improve the cultural grounding of generated interactions
title: Measuring Cultural Alignment Beyond the Average: A Framework for Evaluating Maternal-Health LLM Interactions in Indian Contexts
title_translated: 超越平均值的文化契合度测量：面向印度语境下母婴健康LLM交互的评估框架
summary_translated: 现有的医疗领域大模型评估方法主要关注事实正确性、安全性和流畅性，而对生成交互是否反映文化情境化的医疗推理缺乏深入洞察。这一局限在母婴健康领域尤为关键，因为护理决策受到社会和关系规范的影响。我们提出了MH-INDIC，一个基于文化的评估框架，用于评估北印度城市及半城市地区母婴健康交互，通过母体健康推理的十个维度来操作化文化行为。通过对102名来自北印度城乡地区的孕产妇和产后女性进行26项问卷调查，我们评估了十种大模型。我们区分了群体层面的文化契合度与个体层面的行为差异。尽管多个模型近似于人类群体层面的分布，但所有评估系统在人口统计学和家庭背景下的行为变异性均显著低于人类群体，揭示了整体契合度与个体条件敏感性之间的差距。作为MH-INDIC的下游应用，我们使用表现最强的专有和开源模型，在零样本、自条件和人类引导提示下生成文化条件化的母婴健康对话。结果显示，人类引导条件化产生的对话具有更强的个体契合度和更高的质量评分，表明所测量的文化特征可提升生成交互的文化根基。

summary: Recent advances in large language model (LLM) pretraining highlight the role of high-quality training data in improving performance. While model-based filtering has proven effective in selecting high-quality subsets from web-scale corpora, especially for high-resource languages, low-resource languages face challenges due to limited availability of annotated data. This work explores extending quality filtering to over 100 languages by proposing a multilingual adaptation approach that converts an existing English quality classifier into a multilingual variant. Our approach proposes training a small multi-layer perceptron on top of Transformer encoder-only model embeddings, using multilingual text as input and scores obtained from English classifiers applied to machine-translated text as labels. Our 1B, 3B and 8B scale experiments show that our approach maintains the downstream LLM benchmark performance of existing multilingual model-based filtering baselines, without harming regional and cultural knowledge benchmarks. To further evaluate cross-lingual generalization, we compare classifier scores of high-quality synthetic data and web samples, and the correlation of classifier scores with LLM-based ones, revealing that the classifier can learn the scoring criteria of its original English variant, even for languages not included in its training data.
title: Adapting English Quality Classifiers for Multilingual LLM Pretraining Data Selection
title_translated: 适应英语质量分类器以用于多语言LLM预训练数据选择
summary_translated: 近年来大规模语言模型（LLM）预训练的进步凸显了高质量训练数据在提升性能中的作用。虽然基于模型的过滤方法已被证明在从网络规模语料库中选择高质量子集方面非常有效，尤其适用于高资源语言，但低资源语言由于标注数据有限而面临挑战。本文探索将质量过滤扩展至100多种语言，提出一种多语言适应方法，将现有英语质量分类器转化为多语言版本。我们的方法是在Transformer编码器仅模型嵌入上训练一个小的多层感知机，输入为多语言文本，标签则来自对机器翻译文本应用英语分类器所得分数。10亿、30亿和80亿规模的实验表明，该方法在保持现有多语言模型基线的下游LLM基准性能的同时，未损害区域和文化知识基准表现。为进一步评估跨语言泛化能力，我们比较了高质量合成数据与网络样本的分类器得分，并分析分类器得分与基于LLM的得分之间的相关性，结果表明分类器即使在未参与训练的语言中也能学习其原始英语版本的评分标准。

summary: Sparse Mixture-of-Experts models scale parameter capacity efficiently while maintaining a fixed compute budget per token. However, traditional training paradigms enforce a static choice of top-$k$ experts, which converts a continuous routing distribution into a rigid step function. This constraint introduces a brittle boundary where highly competitive experts are arbitrarily separated into full-supervision and zero-feedback zones based on minor score fluctuations. To address this issue, we propose Elastic Expert Routing, which stochastically samples the active expert budget from a localized discrete distribution centered at $k$. Over multiple training iterations, this mechanism softens the sharp threshold into a gradual probability distribution. Because the sampling neighborhood remains symmetric, this approach matches the expected computational cost of deterministic training, while preserving the inference budget. Extensive experiments demonstrate the efficacy of our method on both supervised fine-tuning and from-scratch pretraining settings. During supervised fine-tuning, elastic routing improves downstream macro-averages on OLMoE-1B-7B and Qwen3-30B-A3B by $+0.84$ and $+2.02$ points, respectively. In addition, in from-scratch pretraining, it outperforms the static top-$k$ baseline by $1.6$ points on average across downstream tasks.
title: Smoothing the Top-k Exposure Boundary for Sparse Mixture-of-Experts
title_translated: 平滑稀疏专家混合模型的Top-k暴露边界
summary_translated: 稀疏专家混合模型在保持每token固定计算预算的前提下，高效扩展参数容量。然而，传统的训练范式强制采用固定的top-$k$专家选择，这将连续的路由分布转化为刚性的阶跃函数。这种约束引入了一个脆弱的边界，使得高度竞争的专家仅因微小的分数波动就被任意划分为全监督和零反馈区域。为解决此问题，我们提出弹性专家路由（Elastic Expert Routing），通过从以$k$为中心的局部离散分布中随机采样活跃专家数量。在多次训练迭代中，该机制将尖锐的阈值软化为渐进的概率分布。由于采样邻域保持对称，该方法在期望计算成本上与确定性训练相当，同时保留推理预算。大量实验表明，该方法在监督微调和从头预训练设置中均有效。在监督微调中，弹性路由分别使OLMoE-1B-7B和Qwen3-30B-A3B的下游宏平均分提升+0.84和+2.02点；在从头预训练中，平均在下游任务上优于静态top-$k$基线1.6点。

summary: Existing Open-Ended Deep Research (OEDR) systems primarily generate reports from scratch, making them inefficient for scenarios where research reports need to be continuously maintained as new information emerges. We introduce \textbf{Incremental Open-Ended Deep Research (Incremental-OEDR)}, a research setting that treats a report as an evolving research state and incrementally updates it by preserving valid knowledge, revising outdated or incomplete content, and incorporating newly available information. To support this setting, we propose \textbf{Structured Harness}, which represents reports as structured collections of outlines, sections, and supporting evidence, and provides structured retrieval, a persistent structured evidence pool, and structured generation for selective report updating and evidence reuse. We further establish a temporal evaluation framework spanning ten years, with \emph{Single-Step Task} and \emph{Long-Chain Task} to evaluate incremental updates over both individual transitions and long-term update chains. Extensive Experiments on DeepResearch Bench and DeepConsult under both the Open-source Configuration (OC) and Proprietary Configuration (PC) show that Incremental-OEDR maintains competitive report quality while substantially improving report continuity and reducing research costs.
