title_translated: 回归风格：一种社会语言学视角下的用户模拟人物一致性建模与度量
summary_translated: 随着代理系统在商业领域的普及，用户模拟器越来越多地作为评估其性能的测量工具。然而，模拟用户与真实人类用户之间的拟真度普遍较低，且通常依赖成本高昂、主观性强的LLM评判者进行评估。在本初步研究中，我们探讨是否可以通过社会语言学视角，将用户角色视为由可观测的语言风格所形成的社交类型，而非依赖标签或描述进行行为推断，从而实现对拟真度的确定性度量。我们以具体风格特征的形式构建角色，从而将两种成熟的、无需模型的工具——作者身份验证风格分析和基于词库的内容分析——转化为拟真度诊断工具。我们在五个面向任务的客户服务代理上，将社会语言学方案与扁平化描述基线进行A/B测试。结果表明，社会语言学方案在多数测试模型中提升了风格一致性与风格可区分性，但需注意：角色风格拟真度并不等同于角色“自然性”。我们认为，社会语言学视角为构建更具多样性与代表性用户角色提供了有前景的方向，而这些指标在错误归因分析中尤为有价值，有助于定位拟真度失效的具体环节。这是迈向使用户模拟更忠实反映多样化、可变性语言输出的重要一步。

summary: Large language models are increasingly used in legal research and drafting, but they can still produce claims that sound convincing without being supported by the cited source. We introduce PARCEL, a benchmark for checking whether a legal claim is supported by the underlying authority. Using recent New York State Court of Appeals decisions, we build a dataset of 3,396 parenthetical-style claims labeled as Supported, Refuted, or Not Found. We cast this task as a three-way natural language inference problem and evaluate several state-of-the-art LLMs in a zero-shot setting. Although the strongest models reach up to 0.97 accuracy, the results also show an important weakness: models still incorrectly mark unsupported claims as supported, even when the full opinion text is provided. Across models, missing support is harder to detect than direct contradiction, and fabricated but plausible citations cause the largest drop in performance. Overall, PARCEL provides a practical benchmark for testing claim-level groundedness in legal RAG systems.
title: When Citations Mislead? A Claim-Level Benchmark for Legal Hallucination Detection
comment: 9 pages, 2 figures, 7 tables. Published in the 21st International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Law (ICAIL 2026), Singapore. Dataset: this https URL
title_translated: 引用误导时？法律幻觉检测的主张级基准
summary_translated: 大型语言模型在法律研究和起草中的应用日益广泛，但仍可能生成看似可信但缺乏引文支持的主张。我们提出了PARCEL，一个用于检验法律主张是否由底层权威支持的基准。基于纽约州上诉法院近期判决，我们构建了一个包含3,396个括号式主张的数据集，标注为“支持”、“反驳”或“未找到”。我们将该任务视为三类自然语言推理问题，并在零样本设置下评估多个最先进的LLM。尽管最强模型准确率可达0.97，但结果也揭示了一个重要弱点：即使提供完整的判决文本，模型仍会错误地标记无支持的主张为有支持。在所有模型中，遗漏支持比直接矛盾更难检测，而虚构但合理的引用导致性能下降最严重。总体而言，PARCEL为测试法律RAG系统中主张级别的事实依据性提供了一个实用的基准。

summary: Large language models (LLMs) are entering wildfire management, where overstated evaluations can cost property and lives. How do they perform on wildfire tasks, with and without grounding? Bare means a model receives the task input alone. Grounded means it also receives one task-specific addition: for smoke detection, a smoke-free reference frame from the same camera. AI4Fire runs six core models bare and grounded on five wildfire tasks, zero-shot; a sweep adds 29 more. Our literature search on fire tasks found 138 works; none combines this roster, task coverage, and paired bare and grounded runs. We report three findings. (1) Grounding helped most where the addition carried the answer: a read-only SQL tool lifted every core model's database accuracy from at most 16 to at least 88 percent. (2) Simple rules were hard to beat: no core model outperformed repeating today's staffing count, and two open-weight models mostly copied the median of similar earlier fire-days, a worse forecast. (3) Public releases carry hazards: a fire-danger column separates the holdout perfectly, and 67 aerial fire frames carry smoldering or fire-free labels read from a clipped thermal maximum. We release prompts, responses, scores, code, and the survey record.
title: AI4Fire: Evaluating Large Language Models on Wildfire Tasks
title_translated: AI4Fire：评估大语言模型在野火任务中的表现
summary_translated: 大语言模型（LLMs）正进入野火管理领域，而过度夸大的评估可能导致财产损失和人员伤亡。它们在有无上下文信息的情况下对野火任务的表现如何？裸模型仅接收任务输入；上下文模型则额外获得一个特定任务的补充信息：例如烟雾检测中，来自同一摄像头的无烟参考帧。AI4Fire 在五个野火任务上以零样本方式测试了六个核心模型的裸模式和上下文模式，一次全面扫描还增加了29个变体。我们对火灾任务相关文献的搜索发现，现有138项研究均未同时具备本研究的模型集合、任务覆盖范围以及成对的裸与上下文运行设置。我们报告三个发现：(1) 当补充信息直接包含答案时，上下文增强效果最显著：仅读取SQL工具便使所有核心模型的数据库准确率从最高16%提升至至少88%；(2) 简单规则难以被超越：没有一个核心模型的表现优于重复当天人员配置数量，两个开源模型大多复制了类似先前火灾日的中位数预测，这是一种更差的预报；(3) 公开发布存在风险：一个火灾危险列能完美区分测试集，且67个空中火灾图像帧携带从热力最大值截取的阴燃或无火标签。我们公开了提示、响应、评分、代码及调查记录。

summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are considered to be a more efficient and cost-effective alternative to human judgment for Machine Translation (MT) evaluation. With MT evaluation spanning a large number of language pairs, domains and levels of annotation granularity, LLMs must be thoroughly evaluated across these dimensions before being reliably used as alternatives to human evaluation. In this paper, we evaluate the performance of LLMs for two prominent MT quality evaluation schemes: Multidimensional Quality Metrics (MQM) and Error Span Annotation (ESA) by comparing their agreement with human annotators. We present results on a long-context test set of 70 language pairs and the publicly available WMT23 and WMT25 data, investigating both score and error span annotation agreement across a variety of language pairs and domains. Our results show that while LLM agreement with human annotators exceeds agreement between human annotators for some evaluation tasks, both vary substantially across annotation schemes, language pairs and domains and remain unreliable for most settings. Furthermore, we identify challenges facing both human and LLM annotators: humans are particularly challenged by fine-grained MQM annotations and low-resource language pairs, while LLMs struggle with minor errors, wrong language variants and error span annotation. Our results highlight the potential for improvement for both human and LLM annotation performance, possibly through human-LLM collaborative annotation pipelines that address the reliability issues identified in this work.
title: Large Language Models for Machine Translation Quality Annotation: Humans and Models Are Both Challenged
title_translated: 大语言模型用于机器翻译质量标注：人类与模型均面临挑战
summary_translated: 大语言模型（LLMs）被视为机器翻译（MT）评估中比人工判断更高效且成本更低的替代方案。由于MT评估涵盖大量语言对、领域和标注粒度层级，LLMs必须在这些维度上进行全面评估后才能可靠地替代人工评估。本文通过比较LLMs与人工标注者的一致性，评估了其在两种主流MT质量评估方案——多维质量度量（MQM）和错误段落标注（ESA）中的表现。我们在包含70种语言对的长上下文测试集以及公开可用的WMT23和WMT25数据上进行实验，考察了不同语言对和领域下的评分与错误段落标注一致性。结果表明，虽然在某些任务中LLMs与人工标注者的吻合度高于人工之间的一致性，但两者在不同评估方案、语言对和领域间差异显著，大多数情况下仍不可靠。此外，我们识别出人类与LLMs共同面临的挑战：人类在细粒度MQM标注和低资源语言对上尤为困难，而LLMs则在微小错误、错误语言变体和错误段落标注上表现不佳。我们的结果突显了改进人类与LLM标注性能的潜力，可能通过构建人机协同标注流程来解决本研究中识别出的可靠性问题。

summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) efficiently transfers capabilities from a stronger teacher to a student language model through dense token-level supervision on student-generated rollouts and has shown promise on complex tasks such as mathematical reasoning. However, in multi-turn agentic tasks, student decisions shape subsequent observations, causing early errors to accumulate across turns. The resulting trajectories can drift away from the teacher's rollout distribution, making the teacher's token-level supervision less reliable or even counterproductive for OPD training. To address this issue, we introduce STI-OPD, a stochastic teacher intervention framework for multi-turn agentic OPD. During multi-turn interaction, STI-OPD uses teacher intervention guided by teacher-student policy discrepancy to replace the student's proposed action with a teacher-generated one to maximize the acquisition of reliable supervision. We further develop a stochastic intervention strategy, addressing the limitations of previous threshold-based or fixed-schedule approaches, that estimates policy discrepancy using KL divergence and maps it to an intervention probability. By sampling whether to intervene from this probability, STI-OPD adaptively balances teacher control with student exploration. To learn from the resulting mixed-policy trajectories, we introduce an Importance-Weighted Reverse KL objective that corrects the token sampling mismatch between teacher-generated responses and the student policy to preserve the original OPD objective. Across tool-integrated reasoning and long-horizon interaction, STI-OPD outperforms the strongest prior OPD baseline on every evaluated benchmark and student size. Ablations further show that both discrepancy-guided intervention and importance weighting contribute to these gains.
title: Stochastic Teacher Intervention for Agentic On-Policy Distillation
title_translated: 面向代理式策略蒸馏的随机教师干预
summary_translated: 策略内蒸馏（OPD）通过学生生成轨迹上的密集token级监督，高效地将强教师模型的能力迁移到学生语言模型，在数学推理等复杂任务中展现出潜力。然而，在多轮代理任务中，学生的决策会影响后续观测，导致早期错误在多轮中累积。由此产生的轨迹可能偏离教师的轨迹分布，使得教师的token级监督对OPD训练变得不可靠甚至适得其反。为解决此问题，我们提出STI-OPD，一种面向多轮代理式OPD的随机教师干预框架。在多轮交互过程中，STI-OPD基于教师-学生策略差异引导教师干预，用教师生成的动作替换学生提议的动作，以最大化可靠监督的获取。我们进一步设计了一种随机干预策略，克服了以往基于阈值或固定周期方法的局限性，利用KL散度估计策略差异，并将其映射为干预概率。通过从该概率中采样决定是否干预，STI-OPD自适应地平衡教师控制与学生探索。为从由此产生的混合策略轨迹中学习，我们引入了一种重要性加权逆KL目标，修正教师生成响应与学生策略之间的token采样不匹配问题，从而保留原始OPD目标。在工具集成推理和长时程交互任务中，STI-OPD在所有评估基准和学生规模下均优于最强的先前OPD基线。消融实验进一步表明，基于差异引导的干预和重要性加权均对性能提升有贡献。

summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) achieve strong performance across many domains, but their efficiency is limited by the quadratic cost of attention with respect to prompt length. Sparse attention reduces this cost by retaining only a small fraction of query-key interactions to approximate the full attention matrix. However, existing methods are trapped in a mathematically wrong view: they simply keep large scalar entries or high-mass regions of the attention matrix. This treats the attention matrix as a bag of values, ignoring that it is used as a structured matrix whose entries jointly determine the attention output through multiplication with value vectors. We argue that this is the core conceptual issue: sparse attention should be formulated as matrix approximation, not as blindly choosing the largest values from a bag of entries. Based on this view, we propose Matrix Approximation Sparse Attention (MASA). MASA replaces raw attention-mass ranking with a closed-form score that measures how much each sparse unit reduces matrix-product approximation error. As a theory-grounded plug-in correction, MASA can be added to existing sparse attention frameworks without changing their sparse kernels or budgets. Extensive experiments across multiple sparse attention methods, benchmarks, and LLM backbones show consistent accuracy gains, supporting both MASA and the matrix-approximation view of sparse attention.
title: Sparse Attention Is Matrix Approximation, Not Choosing from a Bag of Values
title_translated: 稀疏注意力是矩阵近似，而非从值袋中选择
summary_translated: 大语言模型（LLMs）在多个领域表现出色，但其效率受限于注意力机制随提示长度呈二次增长的成本。稀疏注意力通过仅保留少量查询-键交互来近似完整注意力矩阵，从而降低计算成本。然而，现有方法陷入数学上的错误认知：它们简单地保留注意力矩阵中较大的标量值或高密度区域。这将注意力矩阵视为一个值的“袋子”，忽略了其作为结构化矩阵的本质——其元素通过与值向量相乘共同决定注意力输出。我们认为这是核心概念性问题：稀疏注意力应被建模为矩阵近似，而非盲目选取最大值。基于这一观点，我们提出矩阵近似稀疏注意力（MASA）。MASA用一个闭式得分替代原始注意力质量排名，该得分衡量每个稀疏单元对矩阵乘积近似误差的减少程度。作为一种理论驱动的即插即用修正，MASA可无缝集成到现有稀疏注意力框架中，无需改变其稀疏核或预算。在多种稀疏注意力方法、基准和LLM骨干网络上的广泛实验显示一致的精度提升，支持MASA及其矩阵近似视角。

summary: Self-supervised speech encoders contain linguistic and paralinguistic information in a shared, entangled representation space. We combine a TopK sparse autoencoder with route-specific supervision and cross-factor adversaries. Across frozen SPEAR and WavLM encoders, independent probes show factor-specific retention and suppression: linguistic information remains stronger in the linguistic route, while paralinguistic factors, including speaker identity, emotion, and prosody, are retained in the paralinguistic route and substantially reduced in the linguistic route. The route organisation learned on LibriSpeech persists on MSP-Podcast without representation-side retraining. Feature-space route interventions further transfer the swapped factor while largely preserving the information carried by the unchanged route. These results show consistent route-selective separation across encoders, corpora, independent probes, and representation-level interventions.
title: Disentangling Linguistic and Paralinguistic Information with Routed Sparse Autoencoders
title_translated: 通过路由稀疏自编码器解耦语言与副语言信息
summary_translated: 自监督语音编码器在共享的纠缠表示空间中同时包含语言和副语言信息。我们结合TopK稀疏自编码器与路由特定监督及跨因子对抗机制。在冻结的SPEAR和WavLM编码器上，独立探测器显示各因子在特定路由中具有选择性保留与抑制：语言信息在语言路由中保持更强，而说话人身份、情绪和语调等副语言因素则在副语言路由中得以保留，并在语言路由中显著减弱。在LibriSpeech上学习的路由结构在MSP-Podcast上依然有效，无需重新训练表示层。特征空间的路由干预进一步实现了因子交换，同时基本保留未改变路由所携带的信息。这些结果表明，在不同编码器、语料库、独立探测器和表示层面干预中，均存在一致的路由选择性分离。

summary: A large language model can only use the text that fits in its context window, and it recomputes its internal key-value (KV) state for a prompt every time the prompt is sent. We test a memory layer, the public package galahad-kv, that saves the KV state of each block of about 16,000 tokens to encrypted local NVMe disk and loads it back later, byte-exact, without recomputing it. We ran it on 50,000,000 tokens of real public text, served through vLLM on one NVIDIA H100, with Gemma 4 12B and Gemma 4 31B. Every block we probed was loaded back from the encrypted store with no recompute (100 of 100, at depths from 0 to 50M tokens) on both models. Loading a block was 2.8x to 4.3x faster than recomputing it and used 8.8x to 12.3x less GPU energy, and GPU memory stayed flat over the whole 50M-token stream. Asked about facts planted millions of tokens earlier, the 12B model gave the right answer 82 times out of 100 and the 31B model 98 times out of 100. Neither model made up an answer. The limits are as follows. This is reuse of stored state, not a wider attention window: one block is loaded at a time, and how well a question is answered depends on the model. Writing the memory is a one-time cost, and the store takes terabytes of local NVMe disk. We describe the test protocol, which is built to resist common ways of gaming long-context benchmarks, and give a single-GPU reproduction that uses public software and a free licence for the package.
title: Real Long-Term Memory for AI: A 50-Million-Token Window That Is Faster and Cheaper Than Recompute
title_translated: 人工智能的真正长时记忆：一个5000万token窗口，比重新计算更快更便宜
summary_translated: 大型语言模型只能使用其上下文窗口内容纳的文本，并且每次发送提示时都会重新计算其内部键值（KV）状态。我们测试了一个名为galahad-kv的内存层，该层将每个约16,000个token的块的KV状态保存到加密的本地NVMe磁盘中，并在后续以字节精确的方式加载回来，无需重新计算。我们在单个NVIDIA H100上通过vLLM运行了5000万真实公开文本，使用Gemma 4 12B和Gemma 4 31B模型。我们探测的每一个块都成功从加密存储中加载，无需重新计算（100/100，深度范围从0到5000万token），两个模型均表现良好。加载一个块的速度比重新计算快2.8至4.3倍，GPU能耗降低8.8至12.3倍，且在整个5000万token流中GPU内存保持稳定。当被问及数百万token前植入的事实时，12B模型在100次中答对82次，31B模型答对98次，且两个模型均未编造答案。限制条件如下：这是对已存储状态的重用，而非更宽的注意力窗口——一次仅加载一个块，回答质量取决于模型本身。写入内存是一次性成本，存储需要TB级别的本地NVMe磁盘空间。我们描述了测试协议，该协议旨在抵御长期上下文基准测试中常见的作弊方式，并提供了使用公共软件和免费许可证的单GPU可复现方案。

summary: Corrective feedback is among the best-evidenced drivers of second-language acquisition, yet corrections delivered during lessons rarely accumulate into an actionable view of grammar mastery. Prompted frontier models can provide such a view from learner--tutor lesson transcripts, but they are costly at scale. We close this gap by fine-tuning Qwen3.5 small language models (SLMs) on filtered and rebalanced teacher-generated supervision, then deploying an efficient 0.8B model in an end-to-end grammar mastery tracker for all English learners on our platform. Internalizing the annotation contract into adapter weights enables pairing the 0.8B model with a compact matched prompt rather than verbose instructions. On two human-curated benchmarks, both the deployed 0.8B model and a 4B reference comparator outperform prompted GPT-5.4 and GPT-5.6 Sol in precision and recall under nested matching criteria of increasing strictness: concept, evidence span, and correctness. The deployed 0.8B SLM reduces serving cost by approximately 16$\times$. A feature-level online experiment shows significant gains in learner engagement ($+15.8\%$) and key business metrics, including scheduled hours ($+2.1\%$) and GMV from new lessons ($+13.2\%$).
title: Grammar Concept Annotation at Scale: Deployed Fine-Tuned Small Language Models Outperform Prompted Frontier Models
title_translated: 大规模语法概念标注：微调的小型语言模型优于提示式前沿模型
summary_translated: 纠正性反馈是第二语言习得中最有力的证据支持因素之一，但教学过程中提供的纠正很少能积累成可操作的语法掌握视图。提示式前沿模型可以从学习者与导师的课程对话记录中提供这种视图，但在大规模应用中成本高昂。我们通过在过滤并重新平衡的教师生成监督数据上微调Qwen3.5小型语言模型（SLMs），填补了这一空白，随后部署了一个高效的0.8B模型，用于平台所有英语学习者的端到端语法掌握追踪系统。将标注规范内化为适配器权重，使0.8B模型能够与紧凑的匹配提示搭配使用，而非冗长的指令。在两个由人工标注的基准测试中，部署的0.8B模型和一个4B参考模型在嵌套匹配标准（包括概念、证据跨度和正确性）下，精度和召回率均优于提示式GPT-5.4和GPT-5.6 Sol。部署的0.8B SLM将服务成本降低了约16倍。特征级在线实验显示，学习者参与度显著提升（+15.8%），关键业务指标也明显改善，包括预定课时（+2.1%）和新课程带来的GMV（+13.2%）。

summary: Enterprise conversation analytics asks many questions of millions of interactions. Each question can require reconstructing what people mean and identifying which information matters, repeating costly interpretive work across the same transcripts. We propose a simple principle: clarify the text, then focus the reader. Statement normalization transforms dialogue into short, speaker-attributed statements with source references and semantic tags. The statements make meaning more explicit; the tags support selecting evidence for a particular question. Downstream models can use the full representation or a relevant subset, depending on what helps them make the decision. In an offer-suppression task on customer-service calls, normalization improves a supervised classifier without selection, while weaker prompted readers benefit from both normalization and selection. A small model can learn the normalization contract, while lightweight encoders handle tagging and downstream decisions. Sharing this preparation across questions supports an inference pipeline built entirely from small models, making analytics over millions of conversations substantially less expensive.
title: Clarify, Then Focus: Statement Normalization for Conversation Analytics at Scale
title_translated: 先澄清，再聚焦：面向大规模对话分析的语句规范化
summary_translated: 企业级对话分析需要对数百万次互动提出大量问题。每个问题都可能需要重构人们的真实意图并识别相关信息，导致在相同对话记录上重复进行昂贵的解释工作。我们提出一个简单原则：先澄清文本，再聚焦读者。语句规范化将对话转换为带有来源引用和语义标签的简短、发言者归属的陈述。这些陈述使语义更明确；标签则有助于为特定问题选择证据。下游模型可根据需要使用完整表示或相关子集，以帮助其做出决策。在客户客服电话中的报价抑制任务中，规范化提升了无选择的监督分类器性能，而较弱的提示阅读器则同时受益于规范化和选择。一个小模型可以学习规范化规则，轻量级编码器负责标签和下游决策。通过跨问题共享此预处理步骤，构建完全基于小模型的推理流水线，使数百万次对话的分析成本大幅降低。

summary: Our work explores learning a compressed latent representation of text, at the intersection of data compression and representation learning. We propose an autoencoder architecture that performs residual downscaling and upscaling of hidden representations along the time axis, with a residual low-dimension discrete bottleneck. We analyze our approach for different quantization methods, training objectives, and datasets. For different levels of compression, we evaluate the similarity between the original and reconstructed text both at the surface-level (BLEU) and at the semantic-level (LLM-based judge). Additionally, we evaluate our models on downstream question-answering and semantic text similarity benchmarks. Our approach results in compressed representations which are on par with lossless text compression algorithms at 2.24 bits per byte on web text data, while having good reconstruction and downstream task performance.
title: Lossy Compressive Text Autoencoders
title_translated: 有损压缩文本自编码器
summary_translated: 我们的研究探索了在数据压缩与表征学习交叉领域中学习文本的压缩潜在表示。我们提出一种自编码器架构，沿时间轴执行残差降维和升维操作，并采用残差低维离散瓶颈。我们分析了不同量化方法、训练目标和数据集下的方法表现。针对不同压缩级别，我们评估了原始文本与重建文本在表面层面（BLEU）和语义层面（基于大语言模型的评判）的相似性。此外，我们在下游问答和语义文本相似性基准上评估了我们的模型。该方法在网页文本数据上实现了每字节2.24比特的压缩率，与无损文本压缩算法相当，同时具备良好的重建质量和下游任务表现。

summary: How does the human mind represent semantic categories? Why do natural languages favor certain meanings over others? Prior explanations have relied on logical definability and complexity, but these are highly sensitive to the choice of logical language, rendering some design choices unmotivated. In this article, we propose that machine learning provides a somewhat more agnostic approach to measuring semantic complexity. We review emerging evidence that logic and machine learning often yield converging results on relative complexity and its resulting effects in semantic typology. Where they diverge, learning appears to be a better explanation than logical complexity. We argue that treating machine learning models as ``cognitive thermometers'' enables a unified approach to complexity that bridges symbolic logic and connectionist AI.
title: Cognitive Thermometers: Machine Learning and Logical Complexity
title_translated: 认知温度计：机器学习与逻辑复杂性
summary_translated: 人类心智如何表征语义类别？为何自然语言倾向于某些意义而非其他？以往解释依赖于逻辑可定义性和复杂性，但这些方法高度依赖于逻辑语言的选择，使得某些设计选择缺乏动机。本文提出，机器学习提供了一种更为中立的语义复杂性测量方式。我们回顾了新兴证据，表明逻辑与机器学习在相对复杂性及其在语义类型学中的影响方面往往得出一致结果。当两者出现分歧时，学习似乎比逻辑复杂性更能提供合理解释。我们认为，将机器学习模型视为“认知温度计”，能够建立统一的复杂性框架，弥合符号逻辑与连接主义AI之间的鸿沟。

summary: Work zones are critical yet hazardous components of transportation infrastructure, requiring carefully designed Transportation Management Plans (TMPs) to ensure safety and mobility. However, TMP preparation remains labor-intensive and heavily dependent on practitioner expertise. This paper proposes a Large Language Model (LLM)-assisted framework to automate TMP content generation, leveraging the WisDOT WisTMP system as the application context. The framework fine-tunes multiple open-source LLMs across different model scales and deploys them locally to ensure data security. To support model training, we construct a domain-specific dataset from historical WisTMP documents by converting PDF files into structured question-answer pairs in JSON format. Experimental results show that fine-tuning significantly improves performance across standard text generation metrics. Further section-wise and strategy-level analyses reveal that, while LLMs achieve strong overall performance, they tend to over-generate strategies and struggle to produce project-specific justifications and accurate cost estimates. In addition, scaling from 7B/8B to 14B yields limited gains. These findings demonstrate the potential of LLMs to improve TMP preparation efficiency while highlighting remaining challenges in LLM-assisted TMP development. The source code and demo videos will be publicly available at https://zihaosheng.github.io/TMP-LLM/.
title: Large Language Model-Assisted Preparation of Transportation Management Plans: A Case Study with WisDOT WisTMP System
title_translated: 大语言模型辅助交通管理计划编制：以威斯DOT WisTMP系统为例的案例研究
summary_translated: 作业区是交通基础设施中关键但危险的组成部分，需要精心设计的交通管理计划（TMP）以确保安全和通行。然而，TMP的编制仍依赖大量人力且高度依赖从业者经验。本文提出一种基于大语言模型（LLM）的框架，用于自动化TMP内容生成，以威斯DOT WisTMP系统为应用背景。该框架在不同规模的开源LLM上进行微调，并在本地部署以保障数据安全。为支持模型训练，我们通过将历史TMP文档的PDF文件转换为JSON格式的结构化问答对，构建了一个领域特定的数据集。实验结果表明，微调显著提升了标准文本生成指标的表现。进一步的分段和策略级分析显示，尽管LLM整体表现良好，但倾向于过度生成策略，难以生成项目特定的论证和准确的成本估算。此外，从7B/8B扩展到14B带来的收益有限。这些发现展示了LLM在提升TMP编制效率方面的潜力，同时也指出了LLM辅助TMP开发中的现存挑战。源代码和演示视频将公开发布于https://zihaosheng.github.io/TMP-LLM/。

summary: Historical Polish is well documented as a language but annotated in machine-readable form only to about a million words for the period this paper covers; the rest sits behind optical character recognition of variable quality. We present Wieszcz-XIX, a corpus of 6.75 billion tokens (about 3.1 billion words) in 294,369 documents, most of them periodical issues, of Polish published from 1800 to 1918, assembled from Wolne Lektury and the Internet Archive by a pipeline that filters, deduplicates, audits for post-1918 leakage and splits at the document level. It is over three orders of magnitude larger than the annotated corpus of the same period, and we quantify its defects: recognition corruption against a false-positive floor, near-identical duplication, which is removed, and post-1918 leakage, which is excluded from the training corpus itself down to a known residue of 0.04 to 0.38% of its bytes, found in the transcribed source, so the published corpus is the trained one document for document. On a hand-corrected sample the character error rate is 0.68% where the text is legible, and 45% of the sampled passages cannot be corrected. On it we train a ladder of decoder-only models from 47M to 349M parameters from scratch, and measure their temporal boundedness. Against two modern Polish base models, one far larger, the 349M shows a crossover, as does the 107M against the comparator of its size: post-1918 vocabulary costs them about 3.1 bits per byte more than period vocabulary, a gap the comparators do not show, and period vocabulary costs them fewer bits than it costs the comparators. Shown period text, the models keep its spelling and the comparators only partly. Adding parameters gains about twice as much as a second pass over the data. We release the corpus, code and weights. Content warning: the models reproduce period prejudice, including antisemitic statements.
title: Wieszcz-XIX: A 3.1-Billion-Word Corpus of Pre-1918 Polish and Temporally Bounded Language Models Trained From Scratch
comment: 35 pages, 2 figures, 11 tables. Corpus: this https URL ; code: this https URL ; weights: this https URL
title_translated: Wieszcz-XIX：一个31亿词的历史波兰语语料库及从头训练的时间限定语言模型
summary_translated: 历史波兰语虽有充分记录，但可机器读取的标注文本仅约一百万词，覆盖本文所涉时期；其余文本则存在于质量参差不齐的光学字符识别结果中。我们提出了Wieszcz-XIX，一个包含67.5亿个标记（约31亿词）的语料库，由294,369份文档组成，主要为1800至1918年间出版的波兰语期刊，通过从Wolne Lektury和互联网档案馆收集并经管道过滤、去重、审计后1918年后泄漏情况，并按文档级别拆分而成。该语料库规模超过同周期已标注语料库三个数量级，我们量化了其缺陷：识别错误率存在假阳性下限，近似重复已被移除，1918年后泄漏被排除在训练语料之外，残留量为0.04%至0.38%字节，存在于转录源中，因此发布的语料库与训练语料库一一对应。在人工校对样本中，可读文本的字符错误率为0.68%，而45%的采样段落无法修复。在此基础上，我们从头训练了一系列仅解码器的模型，参数量从47M到349M不等，并测量其时间限定性。与两个现代波兰语基础模型对比，349M模型表现出交叉点，107M模型也与同规模比较模型出现交叉：1918年后词汇使它们每字节多出约3.1比特，而比较模型未出现此现象，且1918年前词汇对它们的编码成本低于比较模型。在展示时期文本时，模型保持了当时的拼写方式，而比较模型仅部分保留。增加参数带来的增益约为对数据进行第二轮遍历的两倍。我们发布了语料库、代码和权重。内容警告：模型会复现当时的社会偏见，包括反犹言论。

summary: Personalizing text-to-image diffusion models from a few reference images requires preserving subject identity while following prompts that describe new contexts. Full-model fine-tuning is parameter-intensive, whereas low-rank adaptation (LoRA) reduces the number of trainable parameters but leaves open how adaptation capacity should be distributed across layers. We introduce Diffu-LoRA, a parameter-efficient method that learns this allocation through gated low-rank adaptation. Diffu-LoRA inserts trainable low-rank components into the linear layers of Transformer blocks and assigns a learnable gate to each component. Bilevel optimization updates the adaptation weights and gate parameters on separate data splits, while progressive pruning removes components with the lowest gate values to meet a prescribed rank budget. This procedure allocates adaptation capacity nonuniformly across layers while keeping the pretrained backbone frozen. Experiments with Stable Diffusion on subjects from DreamBooth and additional collected datasets show improved overall subject fidelity and prompt alignment relative to the evaluated fine-tuning baselines. Ablation studies examine the contributions of bilevel optimization, progressive pruning, and adapter placement. These results support learned rank allocation as a practical approach to parameter-efficient diffusion model personalization.
title: Diffu-LoRA: A Novel Low-Rank Adaptation for Personalized Diffusion Models
title_translated: Diffu-LoRA：一种用于个性化扩散模型的新颖低秩适配方法
summary_translated: 从少量参考图像个性化文生图扩散模型，需在遵循提示描述新情境的同时保持主体身份。全模型微调参数密集，而低秩适配（LoRA）虽减少可训练参数，但未明确适配能力应如何在各层间分配。我们提出Diffu-LoRA，一种参数高效的适配方法，通过门控低秩适配学习这一分配策略。Diffu-LoRA在Transformer块的线性层中插入可训练的低秩组件，并为每个组件分配一个可学习的门控机制。双层优化在不同数据子集上分别更新适配权重和门控参数，同时通过渐进式剪枝移除门值最低的组件，以满足预设的秩预算。该过程在保持预训练主干冻结的前提下，非均匀地分配适配能力。在DreamBooth及其他收集数据集上的Stable Diffusion实验表明，相比评估的微调基线，Diffu-LoRA在主体保真度和提示对齐方面均有提升。消融实验分析了双层优化、渐进剪枝和适配器位置的贡献。结果支持学习秩分配作为参数高效扩散模型个性化的实用路径。

summary: Streaming Video Large Language Models (VLMs) enable continuous video understanding, yet existing benchmarks focus on low-dynamic scenarios. Under bounded context budgets, models must balance temporal history, spatial resolution, and temporal granularity; sparse sampling at 1--2 FPS misses fast events. We introduce FastBench to evaluate high-dynamic perception in real-world video streams. Its trajectory-grounded pipeline combines QA generation from high-FPS clips, filtering of questions answerable at 2 FPS, answer verification using SAM3 and CoTracker3 trajectories, and three rounds of human inspection. FastBench contains 306 QA pairs across eight domains, six capabilities, and forward, instant, and backward temporal scopes, with human-annotated evidence intervals. We also present ProactiveFrame, a training-free baseline that adjusts incoming frame rates through text tokens. A dual-tier sliding window retains recent high-FPS observations while downsampling older ones into sparse history. Experiments reveal substantial limitations: the strongest model, Gemini-3.5-Flash, scores only 50.7%. Denser sampling improves Qwen3-VL-8B from 32.9% at 2 FPS to 44.6% at 24 FPS, but gains saturate as history is compressed. ProactiveFrame outperforms sparse uniform sampling by 5.4 and 1.5 percentage points, yet remains well below oracle-guided focusing, showing that current VLMs struggle to determine from the stream alone when finer temporal perception is needed. FastBench provides a testbed for high-dynamic streaming video understanding. Code and data: https://github.com/Ashone3/FastBench.
title: FastBench: Can Streaming VLMs Perceive High-Dynamic Real-World Streams?
title_translated: FastBench：流式视觉语言模型能否感知高动态现实世界视频流？
summary_translated: 流式视频大语言模型（VLM）实现了连续视频理解，但现有基准测试集中于低动态场景。在有限上下文预算下，模型必须平衡时间历史、空间分辨率和时间粒度；以1–2 FPS的稀疏采样会遗漏快速事件。我们引入FastBench，用于评估真实世界视频流中的高动态感知能力。其轨迹引导的流程结合了高帧率片段的问答生成、2 FPS可回答问题的筛选、使用SAM3和CoTracker3轨迹的答案验证，以及三轮人工检查。FastBench包含306组QA对，涵盖八个领域、六种能力，以及前向、即时和后向时间范围，并附有人工标注的证据区间。我们还提出ProactiveFrame，一种无需训练的基线方法，通过文本令牌调整输入帧率。双层滑动窗口保留近期高帧率观测，同时将旧数据降采样为稀疏历史。实验揭示显著局限性：最强模型Gemini-3.5-Flash得分仅为50.7%。更密集采样使Qwen3-VL-8B从2 FPS的32.9%提升至24 FPS的44.6%，但随着历史压缩，增益趋于饱和。ProactiveFrame比稀疏均匀采样分别高出5.4和1.5个百分点，但仍远低于基于Oracle指导的聚焦策略，表明当前VLM难以仅从流中判断何时需要更高时间感知精度。FastBench为高动态流式视频理解提供了一个测试平台。代码与数据：https://github.com/Ashone3/FastBench。

summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) struggle with spatial, embodied, physical, and temporal reasoning. We hypothesize that these failures reflect a shared deficit in visual transition reasoning, and test whether this capability can serve as a shared training primitive, one that different models can learn from different supervision sources and reuse across different tasks, with a systematic training recipe. Existing benchmarks document these deficits separately but do not support controlled comparisons across scenes, actions, and reasoning operations. We therefore introduce WOVEN, a training source and benchmark for visual transition reasoning that organizes transition supervision by scene, action, and reasoning type, using diverse, realistic rollouts from video-pretrained generative models: 36,076 examples across 20 scene types, 5 action types, and 8 reasoning types. We first evaluate 38 frontier MLLMs (e.g., GPT-5.4 and Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B) and find a substantial and systematic deficit: even the strongest models fall far below humans, and the failures recur across model families and persist with scale. We then train MLLMs at multiple scales on WOVEN and find that they learn a shared capability that transfers broadly: training subsets of only about 2,000 items each collectively improve 22 of 26 external benchmarks by up to 27.3 percentage points, and WOVEN data can replace 30-50% of a task's own training data with comparable accuracy. Controlled comparisons further yield a training recipe for visual world modeling, validated prospectively on held-out benchmarks: select supervision by the reasoning operation it teaches rather than by the actions, scenes, or domains it shows, and prefer larger changes to the visual state for robustness. Our work establishes visual transition reasoning as a reusable foundation for systematic visual world-model training in MLLMs.
title: WOVEN: Weaving Visual World Modeling into Multimodal LLMs
title_translated: WOVEN：将视觉世界建模融入多模态大语言模型
summary_translated: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在空间、具身、物理和时间推理方面存在困难。我们假设这些失败源于视觉过渡推理能力的共同缺失，并检验该能力是否可作为共享训练原语——不同模型可从不同监督来源学习，并跨任务复用，同时提供系统性训练方案。现有基准分别记录这些缺陷，但不支持在场景、动作和推理操作间的受控比较。因此，我们引入WOVEN，一个视觉过渡推理的训练资源与基准，按场景、动作和推理类型组织过渡监督，使用来自视频预训练生成模型的多样化、真实感推演：共36,076个示例，涵盖20种场景类型、5种动作类型和8种推理类型。我们首先评估38个前沿MLLMs（如GPT-5.4和Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B），发现存在显著且系统性的缺陷：即使最强模型也远低于人类水平，且失败模式在不同模型家族中反复出现，且随规模增长仍未消除。随后我们在多个尺度上使用WOVEN训练MLLMs，发现它们习得了一项可广泛迁移的共享能力：仅约2,000个样本的子集即可共同提升26个外部基准中的22个，最高达27.3个百分点，且WOVEN数据可替代任务自身训练数据的30%-50%而保持相当精度。受控比较进一步得出视觉世界建模的训练配方，已在预留基准上前瞻性验证：应根据其教授的推理操作选择监督信号，而非根据其展示的动作、场景或领域；优先选择对视觉状态造成较大变化的监督以增强鲁棒性。我们的工作确立了视觉过渡推理作为MLLMs系统性视觉世界建模训练的可复用基础。

summary: Skill-augmented agents improve sample efficiency by distilling successful trajectories into reusable strategies. Yet most existing approaches remain text-centric, linearizing spatial layouts and action-state correspondences into language that loses critical geometric structure. Recent efforts have begun incorporating visual evidence, but construct and update skills separately from policy optimization, leaving their mutual improvement underexplored. We propose ViSkill, a visual-native skill learning framework that encodes successful interactions as composite visual skill cards directly accessible to VLM agents. Retrieved skills guide both inference and reward shaping, while successful trajectories are distilled back into the library, forming a closed feedback loop in which skill accumulation and policy improvement reinforce each other. An optional cold-start mechanism further accelerates early-stage learning. Evaluated on Sokoban, FrozenLake, and PrimitiveSkill, ViSkill achieves an overall success rate of 0.89, rising to 0.91 with cold-start initialization, outperforming all evaluated proprietary and open-source baselines while converging faster than standard PPO. Our code is available at https://github.com/ZJU-REAL/ViSkill.
title: ViSkill: Reinforcing VLM Agents with Evolving Visual-Native Skills
title_translated: ViSkill：通过动态视觉原生技能强化视觉-语言模型智能体
summary_translated: 技能增强型智能体通过将成功轨迹提炼为可复用策略来提升样本效率。然而，大多数现有方法仍以文本为中心，将空间布局和动作-状态对应关系线性化为语言，丢失了关键的几何结构。近期研究开始引入视觉证据，但技能构建与更新与策略优化分离进行，导致二者协同改进尚未得到充分探索。我们提出ViSkill，一种视觉原生技能学习框架，将成功交互编码为可直接供VLM智能体访问的复合视觉技能卡。检索到的技能同时指导推理与奖励塑造，而成功轨迹则被回炼至技能库中，形成一个闭环反馈循环，使技能积累与策略优化相互促进。可选的冷启动机制进一步加速早期学习。在Sokoban、FrozenLake和PrimitiveSkill上的评估显示，ViSkill整体成功率达0.89，采用冷启动初始化后提升至0.91，优于所有评估的专有及开源基线，并且收敛速度超过标准PPO。代码已公开于https://github.com/ZJU-REAL/ViSkill。

summary: Existing spatial reasoning benchmarks mainly test spatial perception: reading off relations already visible in the input. Yet real-world spatial intelligence demands predictive spatial reasoning: constructing a scene from observations, anticipating how an intervention changes it, and reasoning about the unseen outcome. We introduce SpaceCast-Bench, the first benchmark to directly and diagnostically evaluate this capability. Built around an observe-transform-infer framework, its 3,862 questions from 182 real-world scenes span 16 task types at three levels: static perception, local prediction, and global prediction, progressively requiring scene understanding, spatial state updating, and relational inference over unobserved outcomes. Evaluating 21 models exposes a stark gap: the strongest model reaches only 58.0% against 87.2% human performance, while spatially specialized models remain near random chance. Controlled analyses further reveal that bridge views are critical for integrating distributed observations, and that explicit 3D evidence benefits models more reliably than generated outcome images or videos. Fine-tuning on our programmatically generated data lifts Qwen3-VL-4B from 34.0% to 65.7% with macro-average gains across six out-of-domain benchmarks.
title: SpaceCast-Bench: Evaluating Predictive Spatial Reasoning in Vision-Language Models

title_translated: SpaceCast-Bench：评估视觉-语言模型中的预测性空间推理能力
summary_translated: 现有的空间推理基准主要测试空间感知能力：读取输入中已存在的关系。然而，现实世界的空间智能要求预测性空间推理：从观察中构建场景，预判干预如何改变场景，并推理未观测结果。我们提出SpaceCast-Bench，首个直接且诊断性评估该能力的基准。基于观察-变换-推断框架，其包含来自182个真实场景的3,862个问题，涵盖16种任务类型，分为三个层次：静态感知、局部预测和全局预测，逐步要求场景理解、空间状态更新以及对未观测结果的关系推理。对21个模型的评估揭示显著差距：最强模型仅达到58.0%，而人类表现高达87.2%；空间专用模型仍接近随机水平。控制分析进一步表明，桥接视角对于整合分布式观察至关重要，且显式三维证据比生成的结果图像或视频更可靠地提升模型性能。在我们程序生成的数据上微调后，Qwen3-VL-4B从34.0%提升至65.7%，在六个跨域基准上实现宏观平均增益。

summary: Industrial risk-control systems typically rely on structured-data models for efficient prediction, yet substantial valuable information remains embedded in unstructured long text. Extracting this information through manual feature engineering is labor-intensive, while requiring a large language model (LLM) to process every real-time input may not meet practical deployment requirements. To address this challenge, we propose LLM-BlockFE, an LLM-guided offline feature construction framework that converts long text into executable feature programs, thereby avoiding LLM calls during online inference. LLM-BlockFE constructs feature programs by incrementally appending immutable code blocks and evaluates candidate features using a downstream model. To address the tendency of conventional greedy search to become trapped in suboptimal solutions, our method introduces a block-level rollback mechanism based on depth-calibrated credit allocation and advances multiple independent search trajectories in an interleaved manner, reducing redundant exploration by sharing fixed descriptions of each trajectory's exploration direction. After the search, the resulting programs are frozen and deployed to extract structured features for downstream prediction models. Across two public and two private datasets, LLM-BlockFE achieves absolute AUC improvements of 0.0069 to 0.0358 over the strongest baseline on each dataset in the full-dataset comparison. Post-launch monitoring across five deployed financial risk-control applications shows absolute KS improvements of 0.02 to 1.56 percentage points over the existing manually designed strategy.
title: Long Text to Predictive Features: LLM-Guided Blockwise Feature Engineering via Executable Program Search
title_translated: 长文本转预测特征：基于可执行程序搜索的LLM引导分块特征工程
summary_translated: 工业风险控制系统通常依赖结构化数据模型进行高效预测，但大量有价值信息仍嵌入于非结构化长文本中。通过人工特征工程提取这些信息成本高昂，而要求大语言模型（LLM）处理每个实时输入又难以满足实际部署需求。为应对这一挑战，我们提出LLM-BlockFE，一种LLM引导的离线特征构建框架，将长文本转化为可执行特征程序，从而避免在线推理时调用LLM。LLM-BlockFE通过增量追加不可变代码块并利用下游模型评估候选特征来构建特征程序。针对传统贪婪搜索易陷入次优解的问题，我们的方法引入基于深度校准信用分配的块级回滚机制，并以交错方式推进多个独立搜索轨迹，通过共享各轨迹探索方向的固定描述减少冗余探索。搜索完成后，生成的程序被冻结并部署，用于为下游预测模型提取结构化特征。在两个公开和两个私有数据集上，LLM-BlockFE在全数据集比较中相对于最强基线实现了0.0069至0.0358的绝对AUC提升。在五个已部署的金融风控应用上线后监控显示，KS指标绝对提升0.02至1.56个百分点，优于现有手动设计策略。

summary: Agents are deployed in applications from trip planners and stock trading to IT incident triage. In most cases, LLM agents work autonomously with minimal rule-based safeguarding, leading to cost and safety issues from irreversible actions. Recent works resolve this either by using a safeguard agent to monitor behavior or evaluating logs post-hoc. The first adds cost and latency to every step; the second delivers its verdict after the run, when tokens are burned and damage is done. To overcome this, we propose OnTrack, a streaming monitoring mechanism that compares an agent's steps and dependencies against recorded successful runs to alert users or block the agent in about a millisecond per step. We study this problem in three regimes of decreasing access: full reference access (historical runs and tool schemas), intermediate access (only tool schemas), and no prior knowledge (only step logs as generated). Expectation of OnTrack's monitoring capabilities reduces as data access drops, ranging from plan violation detection to identifying loops, stalls, and repeated tool calls. Finally, we evaluate OnTrack using SWE-bench trajectories. Based on the first 8 steps, our method ranks failing trajectories below succeeding ones better than content similarity approaches (+0.057 AUROC). With an abort policy, we save about 18% of compute that would be burned on failing runs, where 83% of interrupted runs were actually heading to failure (5 out of 6 aborts were correct).
title: OnTrack: Real-Time Monitoring and Intervention in LLM Agent Trajectories via Streaming Structure-Aware Optimal Transport
title_translated: OnTrack：基于流式结构感知最优传输的LLM智能体轨迹实时监控与干预
summary_translated: 智能体被应用于行程规划、股票交易到IT事件初步排查等场景。在多数情况下，LLM智能体自主运行，仅依赖少量规则保护，导致因不可逆操作引发成本与安全问题。现有工作要么使用防护智能体监控行为，要么事后评估日志。前者增加每步开销与延迟，后者在运行结束后才给出结论，此时token已消耗、损失已造成。为克服此问题，我们提出OnTrack，一种流式监控机制，通过将智能体步骤及其依赖关系与记录的成功运行进行对比，在每步约一毫秒内提醒用户或阻止智能体。我们在三种访问权限递减的场景下研究该问题：完全参考访问（历史运行与工具模式）、中间访问（仅工具模式）、无先验知识（仅生成的步骤日志）。随着数据访问下降，OnTrack的监控能力逐渐减弱，从计划违规检测，到识别循环、停滞和重复工具调用。最后，我们使用SWE-bench轨迹评估OnTrack。基于前8步，我们的方法在失败轨迹排序上优于内容相似性方法（AUROC提升+0.057）。采用终止策略后，我们节省了约18%的计算资源，其中83%的中断运行确实正走向失败（6次中5次正确终止）。

summary: Large language models increasingly justify legal decisions by naming the statute or precedent behind a verdict, treated as evidence that the decision follows from it. We test this directly: holding case facts fixed, we substitute the named legal authority for an unrelated one and decode a model's evolving verdict from its hidden states. Across seven open-weight models (8B-70B) and four benchmarks spanning judicial and contractual reasoning, when explicitly required to justify a verdict by naming the governing authority, models name the correct one in 66.7%-100% of generations, while the verdict changing when the authority changes is far less consistent: 0.0%-21.7% on CaseHOLD, 30.0%-76.7% on ECHR and SCOTUS, and 43.3%-50.0% on ContractNLI. Neither scale nor a purpose-built legal-reasoning model (a best-effort LoRA reproduction; Section 6) closes this gap. A red-teaming evaluation on five core models finds compliance with an adversarial instruction hidden in the case facts (73.3%-96.4%) exceeds verdict-swap sensitivity by a wide margin, holding without exception across model rankings. Naming a legal authority is thus a poor proxy for a verdict's dependence on it, while the same verdict remains separately vulnerable to adversarial manipulation. Both findings replicate across checks ruling out prompt-wording noise and confounded sampling, and bear directly on the use of generated legal explanations as compliance or audit artefacts.
title: Cited but Not Consulted: A Counterfactual Audit of Legal Chain-of-Thought Faithfulness
title_translated: 被引用却未被咨询：法律链式思维忠实度的反事实审计
summary_translated: 大型语言模型越来越多地通过引用判决背后的法条或判例来解释法律决定，被视为决策源于该依据的证据。我们直接检验这一点：在案件事实固定的情况下，将所引用的法律权威替换为无关项，并从模型隐藏状态解码其演变后的判决。在七个开放权重模型（8B-70B）和四个涵盖司法与合同推理的基准上，当明确要求通过命名管辖权威来解释判决时，模型在66.7%-100%的生成中命名了正确权威，但当权威变更时判决随之变化的情况远不一致：CaseHOLD上为0.0%-21.7%，ECHR和SCOTUS上为30.0%-76.7%，ContractNLI上为43.3%-50.0%。无论规模大小，还是专门构建的法律推理模型（最佳努力的LoRA复现；第6节），均无法弥合这一差距。对五个核心模型的红队测试发现，模型对隐含于案件事实中的对抗指令的遵从性（73.3%-96.4%）远超判决交换敏感性，且在所有模型排名中均成立。因此，引用法律权威并不能良好反映判决对其的依赖性，而同一判决仍可能单独受到对抗性操纵的影响。两项发现均在排除提示词噪声和采样混淆的检查中重现，直接关乎生成法律解释作为合规或审计文件的可信度。

summary: When retrieved evidence contradicts an agent's prior beliefs, does it revise its answer, acknowledge uncertainty, or persist with an incorrect conclusion? Existing evaluations of agentic systems focus primarily on task success, offering limited insight into how agents handle such conflicts. We propose to evaluate agents on epistemic humility (EH): the agent's willingness to recognize, act on, and communicate uncertainty during task execution. We operationalize EH through three trajectory-level behavioral dimensions: Identify, Solve, and Escalate (ISE). Through knowledge conflict, situations where the backbone language model's parametric knowledge contradicts the evidence it encounters, or where two contextual sources disagree, we evaluate two conflict settings: (1) controlled conflict and (2) naturally occurring conflict during multi-step agentic execution, each paired with matched no-conflict controls. Evaluating four agents, we find that higher task accuracy does not necessarily correspond to greater epistemic humility: some high-accuracy configurations recognize conflicts during execution but do not communicate unresolved uncertainty in their incorrect final answers. Trajectory-level analysis further reveals that agents frequently detect conflicts in early steps of execution but fail to maintain or resolve them in later steps. Finally, we show that model-level interventions can improve EH, but often at the cost of task accuracy, suggesting that epistemic humility emerges from the interaction among the backbone model, agent harness, and evaluation environment.
title: Accurate but Not Humble: Evaluating Epistemic Humility in LLM Agents under Knowledge Conflict
title_translated: 准确但不谦逊：在知识冲突下评估大语言模型智能体的元认知谦逊
summary_translated: 当检索到的证据与智能体的先验信念相矛盾时，它是否会修正答案、承认不确定性，或坚持错误结论？现有对智能体系统的评估主要关注任务成功率，难以揭示智能体如何处理此类冲突。我们提出从元认知谦逊（Epistemic Humility, EH）角度评估智能体：即智能体在任务执行过程中识别、应对并传达不确定性的意愿。我们通过三个轨迹级行为维度——识别（Identify）、解决（Solve）和升级（Escalate），即ISE框架来操作化EH。通过知识冲突场景（如基础语言模型的参数化知识与遇到的证据矛盾，或两个上下文来源意见不一），我们评估了两种冲突设置：（1）受控冲突和（2）多步智能体执行过程中的自然发生冲突，每种均配有对应的无冲突对照组。对四种智能体的评估发现，更高的任务准确性并不必然对应更强的元认知谦逊：部分高准确率配置虽能在执行中识别冲突，却未在最终错误答案中传达未解决的不确定性。轨迹级分析进一步显示，智能体常在执行早期检测到冲突，但在后期未能维持或解决。最后，我们证明模型层面的干预可提升EH，但往往以牺牲任务准确率为代价，表明元认知谦逊源于基础模型、智能体架构与评估环境之间的交互作用。

summary: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) adapts pretrained large language models (LLMs) to downstream tasks, but the required concepts can receive substantially different levels of pretrained support. Frequent concepts are more likely to be well learned, whereas rare concepts may remain weakly represented. We introduce a novel notion named prior barrier to quantify how strongly the pretrained model supports competing concepts over the target concept. We observe that prior barriers follow a long-tail distribution, placing head and tail concepts at different starting points for SFT: head concepts face lower prior barriers, whereas tail concepts require additional instructions to overcome their higher prior barriers. Our theoretical analysis further derives a predictive risk bound for SFT under long-tail prior barriers, explicitly characterizing how the prior barrier and accumulated SFT evidence jointly determine predictive performance. Motivated by this prior barrier-dependent demand, we propose PASS, an adaptive SFT instruction selection method that constructs reference-derived concepts and estimates the distinguishing evidence provided by each instruction, and adaptively allocates the selection budget toward concepts that remain insufficiently covered under the current selection. In this way, PASS jointly considers which instructions can provide useful evidence and where additional supervision is needed under a limited budget. Experiments show that our method consistently outperforms seven state-of-the-art instruction selection methods on four backbone-budget settings. An ablation study further shows that PASS's adaptive allocation consistently improves over uniform allocation.
title: Overcoming Prior Barriers: Supervised Fine-Tuning under Long-Tail Distribution
title_translated: 克服先验障碍：长尾分布下的监督微调
summary_translated: 监督微调（SFT）将预训练的大语言模型（LLM）适配到下游任务，但所需概念可能获得显著不同的预训练支持水平。高频概念更易被充分学习，而低频概念则可能仍处于弱表示状态。我们引入一个新概念‘先验障碍’，用于量化预训练模型对竞争概念相对于目标概念的支持强度。我们观察到先验障碍遵循长尾分布，使头部和尾部概念在SFT起点上存在差异：头部概念面临较低的先验障碍，而尾部概念需要额外指令以克服更高的先验障碍。我们的理论分析进一步推导出在长尾先验障碍下的SFT预测风险边界，明确刻画了先验障碍与累积SFT证据如何共同决定预测性能。受此先验障碍依赖需求驱动，我们提出PASS方法，一种自适应SFT指令选择机制，通过构建基于参考的衍生概念，并估计每条指令提供的区分性证据，自适应地将选择预算分配给当前覆盖不足的概念。因此，PASS同时考虑哪些指令能提供有用证据，以及在有限预算下何处需要额外监督。实验表明，我们的方法在四个骨干模型-预算设置下持续优于七种最先进的指令选择方法。消融研究进一步表明，PASS的自适应分配始终优于均匀分配。

summary: Adversarial games have driven advances from heuristic search to reinforcement learning, yet learning and adapting strategies from limited samples remain challenging. AI agents offer an alternative by turning game experience into revisions of executable policies. Building on heuristic learning (HL), we formalize Adversarial Heuristic Learning (AHL), a paradigm that uses AI agents as learning engines to refine game policies and supporting software while keeping model weights fixed. We introduce AAArena, a benchmark comprising 12 authentic adversarial games and 1,920 archived human programs, with an evaluation protocol modeled on real-world game competitions. Agents interpret rules, choose opponents, analyze replays, and revise game agents to achieve their highest ranking within fixed match and evaluation budgets. We evaluate \val{completedmodels} model and harness configurations: Opus5.5 with Claude Code earns 6 gold medals, while no evaluated configuration tops the remaining 6 human ladders. Performance is generally weaker in games with more complex rule specifications. Further experiments show that opponent selection and dense feedback support policy improvement, and that agents learn from both on-policy replays of their own matches and off-policy replays of other players' matches. These results highlight HL's potential in adversarial games and identify persistent challenges in game understanding, strategy implementation, and long-horizon policy development.
title: Can AI Agents Learn Their Way to the Top? Evaluating Heuristic Learning in a Long-Running Game Agent Competition
title_translated: AI智能体能否学会登顶？在长期运行的游戏智能体竞赛中评估启发式学习
summary_translated: 对抗性游戏推动了从启发式搜索到强化学习的发展，但仅凭有限样本学习和适应策略仍具挑战性。AI智能体提供了一种替代路径，即将游戏经验转化为可执行策略的迭代更新。基于启发式学习（HL），我们形式化了对抗性启发式学习（AHL）范式，利用AI智能体作为学习引擎，在保持模型权重不变的前提下，优化游戏策略及相关软件。我们引入AAArena基准，包含12个真实对抗性游戏和1,920个归档的人类程序，其评估协议模拟真实世界游戏竞赛。智能体需解读规则、选择对手、分析回放，并修订游戏智能体，以在固定比赛和评估预算内取得最高排名。我们评估了	exttt{completedmodels}种模型与架构配置：Opus5.5搭配Claude Code赢得6枚金牌，而其他所有配置均未能超越剩余6个人类排行榜。总体表现较弱的游戏通常具有更复杂的规则设定。进一步实验表明，对手选择和密集反馈有助于策略改进，且智能体能从自身对策略的在线回放和他人离线回放中学习。这些结果凸显了启发式学习在对抗性游戏中的潜力，并指出了在游戏理解、策略实现和长周期策略开发方面仍存在的持久挑战。

summary: The memory-bound nature of the decoding stage of large language model (LLM) inference incurs significant latency. Layer-wise training-free network pruning approaches guided by the Hessian have been a prominent solution to this problem, as pruning reduces the number of nonzero parameters read from memory during decoding. Nevertheless, typical methods in this line compute the Hessian using pre-collected natural sequences, whereas the model is fed self-generated tokens during decoding, creating a distribution shift between the two sequences. The Hessian calculated on the natural sequence is different from that calculated on the generated sequence. We observe that this discrepancy causes the activation distribution during generation to deviate from that used for pruning, further hurting the pruned model performance. Moreover, most existing LLM pruning methods that bring actual speedup primarily target the sparse matrix-matrix (SpMM) multiplication, providing limited support for the sparse matrix-vector (SpMV) operations, which dominate decoding. To solve these problems, we introduce SparseDecoding, a principled decoding-aware pruning framework tailored for accurate and efficient LLM decoding. Specifically, at the algorithmic axis, SparseDecoding constructs calibration matrices from layer-wise activations collected during the dense-model autoregressive generation, excluding prefill, thereby aligning the pruning objective with the decoding activations. At the system axis, we develop an optimized N:M sparse matrix-vector kernel with bitmask indexing and fixed-step traversal. Substantial empirical results on representative LLMs (Llama-3.1-8B, Llama-3.3-70B, Qwen3-14B / 32B) demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms standard fixed-text calibration on the long-form generation benchmarks while achieving up to 1.48x end-to-end wall-clock decoding speedup on A100 GPUs.
title: SparseDecoding: Decoding-Aware Pruning for Accurate and Efficient LLM Inference
title_translated: SparseDecoding：面向精准高效大语言模型推理的解码感知剪枝
summary_translated: 大语言模型（LLM）推理阶段的内存瓶颈导致显著延迟。基于Hessian的逐层无训练网络剪枝方法是解决该问题的主流方案，因为剪枝可减少解码过程中从内存读取的非零参数数量。然而，这类典型方法使用预先收集的自然序列计算Hessian，而解码阶段模型输入的是自生成的标记，造成两序列间分布偏移。在自然序列上计算的Hessian与在生成序列上计算的Hessian不同。我们观察到这种差异导致生成过程中的激活分布偏离剪枝所用分布，进一步损害剪枝后模型的性能。此外，大多数能带来实际加速的现有LLM剪枝方法主要针对稀疏矩阵-矩阵乘法（SpMM），对主导解码的稀疏矩阵-向量乘法（SpMV）支持有限。为解决这些问题，我们提出SparseDecoding，一种原则性的解码感知剪枝框架，专为精准高效的LLM解码设计。在算法层面，SparseDecoding通过在密集模型自回归生成过程中（排除预填充阶段）收集各层激活，构建校准矩阵，从而将剪枝目标与解码激活对齐。在系统层面，我们开发了优化的N:M稀疏矩阵-向量核，采用位掩码索引和固定步长遍历。在代表性LLM（Llama-3.1-8B、Llama-3.3-70B、Qwen3-14B / 32B）上的大量实验证明，我们的方法在长文本生成基准上持续优于标准固定文本校准方法，同时在A100 GPU上实现了高达1.48倍的端到端墙钟解码速度提升。

summary: Large language model compliance systems are deployed on the assumption that a verdict depends on the regulatory rule it is given. We test this directly across five models and 20 regulatory and platform-policy domains: delete, swap, or negate the governing rule while holding the case fixed, and check whether the verdict changes (OCS) or the model's internal representation of compliance shifts at all (ICS-delta). Neither moves much: models' verdicts are often invariant to substantial perturbations of the supplied rule, and the guard model, evaluated here under a custom-rule adaptation of its native taxonomy, is the least rule-sensitive and least accurate of the five, barely above chance (51%, versus 90-92% for general-purpose models). This reflects easy cases more than blanket neglect: on cases where deleting the rule changes a previously correct model prediction, models do track it closely. Neither better prompting nor direct intervention on the model's internal representations closes this gap. Accuracy alone does not establish that a compliance verdict is grounded in the supplied rule.
title: Verdict Without the Rule: Diagnosing and Auditing Regulatory Rule Sensitivity in LLM Compliance Systems
title_translated: 无需规则即可裁决：诊断与审计大语言模型合规系统对监管规则的敏感性
summary_translated: 大型语言模型合规系统部署的前提是裁决结果取决于其所接收的监管规则。我们直接在五个模型和20个监管及平台政策领域中进行测试：在保持案件不变的情况下，删除、替换或否定核心规则，检查裁决是否发生变化（OCS），或模型内部对合规性的表征是否发生任何变化（ICS-delta）。结果显示两者变化均很小：模型的裁决对所提供规则的重大扰动往往保持不变；在此评估中，作为自定义规则适应其原生分类体系的守门模型，是五者中最不敏感、最不准确的，仅略高于随机水平（51%，而通用模型为90%-92%）。这反映的并非全面忽视，而是对简单案例的偏好：在删除规则会改变先前正确预测的案例中，模型确实能紧密跟踪规则变化。无论是更好的提示工程还是对模型内部表征的直接干预，都无法弥合这一差距。仅凭准确性无法证明合规裁决是基于所提供规则的。

summary: Dense retrieval usually ranks text chunks by their semantic similarity to a question. This ignores structure that many data systems already store, including section membership, session boundaries, and native order. We propose NativeScope, a scope-then-rank method for queries with a known anchor and relation. It represents a query as q -> (A, r, B). The anchor A and relation r select native units through belonging, before, or after operators, and the target term B ranks only chunks that overlap the selected scope. An internal variant, NS-FullQ, ranks the same candidates with the full question. We evaluate both methods on 200 controlled document and memory records derived from QASPER and LongMemEval under a 1,024-token budget. NativeScope attains native-unit recall of 89.28 percent for documents and 72.50 percent for memories, improving over instance-wide Dense RAG by 42.75 and 22.00 percentage points. NS-FullQ reaches 87.78 percent and 68.50 percent; its differences from NativeScope are inconclusive, locating the primary gain in relational scoping rather than the shorter ranking query. With automatic Top-1 anchors, memory recall falls to 35.50 percent. NativeScope is therefore effective when anchor coordinates and native relations are reliable, but hard scoping inherits errors from the localization interface.
title: NativeScope: Relation-Localized Retrieval over Native Topology with a Correct Anchor
comment: 14 pages, 4 figures, and 6 tables. Includes an appendix with reproduction information and an evidence inventory
title_translated: NativeScope：基于已知锚点与关系的原生拓扑局部化检索
summary_translated: 密集检索通常根据文本片段与问题的语义相似性进行排序，但忽略了数据系统中已有的结构信息，如章节归属、会话边界和原生顺序。我们提出NativeScope，一种针对已知锚点和关系查询的‘范围优先、再排序’方法。该方法将查询表示为 q -> (A, r, B)，其中锚点A和关系r通过所属、之前或之后等操作符选择原生单元，目标项B仅对与所选范围重叠的片段进行排序。其内部变体NS-FullQ使用完整问题对相同候选进行排序。我们在200个源自QASPER和LongMemEval的受控文档与记忆记录上，在1024 token预算下评估了两种方法。NativeScope在文档上的原生单元召回率达到89.28%，在记忆上达到72.50%，相比实例级密集RAG分别提升42.75和22.00个百分点。NS-FullQ分别达到87.78%和68.50%；两者差异不显著，表明主要增益来自关系性范围限定而非更短的排序查询。当使用自动Top-1锚点时，记忆召回率下降至35.50%。因此，当锚点坐标和原生关系可靠时，NativeScope有效，但硬性范围限定会继承定位接口中的错误。

summary: Recent full-duplex spoken dialog models enable simultaneous listening and speaking, but fine-grained models still advance their backbone autoregressively at every interaction frame. We introduce DiffuPlex, a rolling masked diffusion framework that reduces this sequential computation by predicting multiple future user and assistant frames in a single backbone wake. DiffuPlex consumes only a confident prefix of each predicted future while interaction continues at the original frame rate. As user speech arrives, it checks the corresponding user predictions and, when the interaction diverges, preserves already played assistant content while revising only the unplayed future. We consider two inference policies over the same predictor: DiffuPlex-LISTEN consumes multiple future frames when they predict assistant silence, whereas DiffuPlex-SPEAK can also consume predicted assistant speech. Across full-duplex interaction and spoken-language evaluations, DiffuPlex substantially reduces sequential backbone computation while largely preserving interaction behavior and general capability. DiffuPlex-LISTEN and DiffuPlex-SPEAK achieve $1.46\times$ and $1.59\times$ deployment-path wall-clock speedups and $1.61\times$ and $1.80\times$ Core LM speedups, with all measured backbone invocations completing within the 80ms interaction interval. Human evaluation shows that LISTEN preserves speech naturalness and conversational quality, while SPEAK retains conversational quality with some degradation in speech naturalness.
title: DiffuPlex: Accelerating Full-Duplex Spoken Dialog Models via Rolling Masked Diffusion

title_translated: DiffuPlex：通过滚动掩码扩散加速全双工语音对话模型
summary_translated: 近期的全双工语音对话模型实现了同时听与说的能力，但细粒度模型仍需在每个交互帧上自回归地推进其主干网络。我们提出DiffuPlex，一种滚动掩码扩散框架，通过单次主干唤醒预测多个未来用户与助手帧，从而减少这种串行计算。DiffuPlex仅消耗每个预测未来帧中可信的前缀部分，同时保持原始帧率的交互速度。当用户语音到达时，它会检查对应的用户预测，若交互出现分歧，则保留已播放的助手内容，仅修正未播放的未来部分。我们考虑同一预测器上的两种推理策略：DiffuPlex-LISTEN在预测助手沉默时消耗多个未来帧，而DiffuPlex-SPEAK还可消耗预测的助手语音。在全双工交互和语音语言评估中，DiffuPlex显著减少了主干网络的串行计算量，同时基本保持了交互行为与通用能力。DiffuPlex-LISTEN和DiffuPlex-SPEAK分别实现1.46倍和1.59倍的部署路径时钟速度提升，以及1.61倍和1.80倍的核心语言模型速度提升，所有测量的主干调用均在80ms交互间隔内完成。人工评估显示，LISTEN保持了语音自然性和对话质量，而SPEAK虽略有语音自然性下降，但仍维持良好对话质量。

summary: Full-duplex speech models can listen and speak simultaneously, enabling natural interaction, but become increasingly difficult to control as the conversation history grows. When used as user simulators, this lack of control can cause them to deviate from prescribed scenarios and produce unreliable evaluation outcomes. We introduce SimIF-Bench (Simulator Instruction-Following Benchmark), which evaluates whether a conversational model stays within a prescribed scenario and completes multiple goals in the required order. The benchmark reveals that current open-source full-duplex models struggle to follow such constraints. We then introduce a Group Reward-Decoupled Normalization Policy Optimization (GDPO)-based training recipe that enables a full-duplex model to follow textual instructions during an ongoing conversation while maintaining its turn-taking ability. By connecting the resulting SteerablePlex to an asynchronous backend language model that monitors the conversation and provides instructions when needed, we build a more controllable full-duplex user simulator that follows multi-stage constraints more reliably than existing open-source models and GPT-Realtime.
title: SteerablePlex: Can We Steer Full-Duplex Models?
title_translated: SteerablePlex：我们能否控制全双工模型？
summary_translated: 全双工语音模型可同时听与说，实现自然交互，但随着对话历史增长，其控制难度日益增加。当用作用户模拟器时，这种缺乏控制可能导致模型偏离预定场景，产生不可靠的评估结果。我们引入SimIF-Bench（模拟器指令遵循基准），用于评估对话模型是否能在规定场景内完成多个目标并按正确顺序执行。基准测试揭示当前开源全双工模型难以遵循此类约束。随后，我们提出一种基于组奖励解耦归一化策略优化（GDPO）的训练方法，使全双工模型在对话过程中能遵循文本指令，同时保持轮流发言能力。通过将生成的SteerablePlex连接到异步后端语言模型，该模型可监控对话并在需要时提供指令，构建出比现有开源模型及GPT-Realtime更可靠地遵循多阶段约束的可控全双工用户模拟器。

summary: Why does removing reference-policy KL regularization sometimes improve group policy optimization? This motivates studying how reference-policy information should enter group-relative updates. We analyze seven potential failure modes in the interactions between KL and rewards: residual KL updates after reward clipping, after gradient cancellation, and in groups with identical rewards; KL growth with response length and an imbalance in its relative contribution; KL concentration on a small number of tokens; and sampling noise when k1 is incorporated into rewards. We propose Zero-Sum Calibrated Policy Optimization (ZCPO), which uses relative drift measured by conditional KL to calibrate within-group reward coefficients and integrates them into the base surrogate. Mathematical reasoning experiments and ablations support this design's effectiveness in our settings.
title: When KL Regularization Misfires in Group Policy Optimization
title_translated: 组策略优化中KL正则化失效的时机分析
summary_translated: 为何移除参考策略的KL正则化有时反而能提升组策略优化效果？这促使我们研究参考策略信息应如何融入组相对更新中。我们分析了KL与奖励之间交互的七种潜在失败模式：奖励裁剪后的残余KL更新、梯度抵消后的KL更新、奖励相同的组中KL的增长；响应长度增长导致的KL增长及其相对贡献失衡；KL集中在少数token上；以及在奖励中引入k1时的采样噪声。我们提出零和校准策略优化（ZCPO），利用条件KL测量的相对漂移来校准组内奖励系数，并将其整合进基础代理函数。数学推理实验与消融研究支持该设计在我们设定下的有效性。

summary: Large language model (LLM)-based agents have demonstrated strong capabilities on complex tasks. They typically perform reasoning before each action throughout an interaction trajectory. However, reasoning may not be necessary at every turn, as reasoning produced earlier can continue to support subsequent actions. A key challenge is therefore to determine when existing reasoning remains sufficient and when a new reasoning step is needed, without relying on costly generation-based verification. We find that decreases in the likelihood of subsequent reference actions after removing additional reasoning closely track whether those actions remain recoverable given earlier reasoning, providing an effective and lightweight signal for estimating cross-turn action support. Based on this observation, we propose Reasoning Adaptation through Cross-Turn Estimation (RACE), a training approach for adaptive agent reasoning. RACE introduces a Likelihood-Guided Progressive Reasoning Cover Detection (LoGiC) procedure that progressively identifies reasoning turns whose removal has limited impact on the current and subsequent reference actions. The resulting removal signals are incorporated into both supervised fine-tuning and agentic reinforcement learning, enabling the policy to learn when to reason and when to act directly. Extensive experiments on four representative agent benchmarks show that RACE substantially reduces reasoning cost while maintaining or improving task performance.
title: When Should Agents Think? Adaptive Reasoning via Cross-Turn Estimation
title_translated: 智能体何时应思考？基于跨轮次估计的自适应推理
summary_translated: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体在复杂任务中展现出强大能力。它们通常在每次交互中都进行推理。然而，推理并非每一轮都必要，因为早期产生的推理可能持续支持后续动作。关键挑战在于判断已有推理是否足够，以及何时需要新的推理步骤，而不依赖于代价高昂的生成式验证。我们发现，在移除额外推理后，后续参考动作概率的下降程度与这些动作是否仍可由早期推理恢复高度相关，从而提供了一种有效且轻量的跨轮次动作支持估计信号。基于此观察，我们提出通过跨轮次估计实现推理自适应（RACE），一种用于自适应智能体推理的训练方法。RACE引入一种似然引导的渐进推理覆盖检测（LoGiC）过程，逐步识别那些移除后对当前及后续参考动作影响有限的推理轮次。由此产生的移除信号被纳入监督微调与智能体强化学习中，使策略学会何时推理、何时直接行动。在四个代表性智能体基准上的大量实验表明，RACE显著降低了推理成本，同时保持甚至提升了任务性能。

summary: Increasingly, AI interviewers are being developed to elicit open-ended responses in applications like market research, public polling, preference elicitation, and social science research. However, evaluating AI interviewers is challenging because they function in extended, multi-turn interactions where they must adapt to participant behaviors. To address this need, we develop InterviewPlayground, a simulation environment for evaluating AI interviewers using simulated study participants whose behaviors are grounded in social theory. Simulated studies in InterviewPlayground produce an InterviewReportCard, which assesses the performance of AI interviewers using a suite of validated measures. To test whether our simulation-based evaluations predict performance with human participants, we conduct 15 real qualitative studies with five AI interviewers, three interview topics, and 450 human participants and compare them to simulated studies in InterviewPlayground. We find that AI interviewer performance in InterviewPlayground predicts performance in human studies with an average Pearson correlation of 0.86 across 12 measures, and the simulated interactions from InterviewPlayground reproduce key findings from behavioral analysis of AI interviewers in the human studies. Together, these findings support the validity of InterviewPlayground in assessing AI interviewer performance and examining potential failure modes. Our work contributes a simulation environment for AI interviewers supported with empirical validation, and more broadly, a roadmap for future work to develop validated, simulation-based evaluations of conversational AI systems.
title: InterviewPlayground: A Simulation Environment for Evaluating AI Interviewers
title_translated: InterviewPlayground：用于评估AI面试官的仿真环境
summary_translated: 越来越多的AI面试官被开发出来，用于市场调研、公众投票、偏好获取和社会科学研究等场景中，以引出开放式回答。然而，评估AI面试官具有挑战性，因为它们在长时间、多轮交互中必须适应参与者的行为。为解决这一问题，我们开发了InterviewPlayground，一个基于社会理论驱动的模拟研究参与者行为的仿真环境，用于评估AI面试官。在InterviewPlayground中进行的模拟研究会生成一份InterviewReportCard，使用一系列经过验证的指标评估AI面试官的表现。为了检验我们的基于仿真的评估是否能预测与人类参与者的实际表现，我们进行了15项真实定性研究，涉及五种AI面试官、三个访谈主题和450名人类参与者，并将其与InterviewPlayground中的模拟研究进行对比。结果发现，AI面试官在InterviewPlayground中的表现与在人类研究中的表现具有高度相关性（12项指标的平均皮尔逊相关系数为0.86），且模拟交互重现了人类研究中AI面试官行为分析的关键发现。这些结果支持InterviewPlayground在评估AI面试官性能及识别潜在失效模式方面的有效性。我们的工作提供了一个经实证验证的AI面试官仿真环境，更广泛地为未来开发经过验证的对话式AI系统仿真评估提供了路线图。

summary: Test-time training (TTT) adapts an LLM's parameters using signals derived from test inputs, and can make striking improvements in pre-specified settings such as IMO competitions or designated open problems. By turning deployment experience into parameter updates, TTT provides a direct mechanism for model-level self-improvement. Yet TTT is not universally beneficial: each TTT algorithm works in different settings, and applying an ill-suited method could waste test-time compute or even damage model performance. Therefore, such parameter-level self-improvement requires agency: the model must decide when TTT is warranted, which algorithm to invoke, and whether an existing skill can be reused. To fill this gap, we introduce Agentic-TTT, which learns a test-time policy to govern those decisions. Agentic-TTT turns TTT procedures into callable tools, treats accumulated skills as an evolving deployment environment, and trains its policy using the observed utility gains from its decisions. On our benchmark, Agentic-TTT nearly doubles the utility over the backbone model, learns to trade off utility against compute, and generalizes to domains unseen during training. Together, these results point toward autonomous self-improvement: models that can decide how to learn from their own deployment experience.
title: Agentic-TTT: Training test-time policy for test-time training
title_translated: Agentic-TTT：用于测试时训练的智能体测试时策略
summary_translated: 测试时训练（TTT）通过利用测试输入信号来调整大语言模型的参数，在特定任务如IMO竞赛或指定开放问题中可带来显著提升。通过将部署经验转化为参数更新，TTT为模型层面的自我改进提供了直接机制。然而，TTT并非普遍有益：每种TTT算法适用于不同场景，使用不合适的算法可能浪费测试时间计算资源，甚至损害模型性能。因此，这种参数级自我改进需要具备代理能力——即模型必须自主决定何时启用TTT、调用何种算法，以及是否可复用已有技能。为填补这一空白，我们提出Agentic-TTT，它学习一种测试时策略来管理这些决策。Agentic-TTT将TTT过程变为可调用工具，将积累的技能视为动态演化的部署环境，并利用其决策带来的实际收益来训练策略。在基准测试中，Agentic-TTT的效用几乎达到基础模型的两倍，学会在效用与计算成本之间权衡，并泛化到训练期间未见的领域。这些结果共同指向自主自我改进：能够自主决定如何从自身部署经验中学习的模型。

summary: Data video is a media form that integrates data visualization with video narrative, widely adopted in news reporting and business analysis. Compared with general video understanding, data video understanding places greater emphasis on accurately reading data from animated charts, integrating evidence across charts and time, and understanding how narrative organization and visual design communicate information. Yet existing benchmarks target either general videos or static charts, and data video understanding has not been systematically evaluated. We present DataVista, the first benchmark for data video understanding, containing 961 real-world data videos and 6,775 evaluation questions organized under a three-level progressive capability framework (data perception, temporal reasoning, narrative understanding) with 10 fine-grained question types across five topic domains. Systematic evaluation of 19 mainstream MLLMs shows that the best-performing model, Gemini-3.1-Pro, achieves 70.0% overall accuracy, still far below human expert performance, with models performing worst on Causal Reasoning and Narrative Structure. Increasing frame counts and adding subtitles mainly benefit data perception and temporal reasoning, with limited gains in narrative understanding. Further analysis of model responses identifies typical failure modes in chart reading, evidence judgment, and instruction understanding. The benchmark is available at https://github.com/HKUSTDial/DataVista.
title: DataVista: Diagnosing Multimodal LLMs on Data Video Understanding
title_translated: DataVista：针对数据视频理解的多模态大模型诊断基准
summary_translated: 数据视频是一种将数据可视化与视频叙事相结合的媒体形式，广泛应用于新闻报道和商业分析中。相较于通用视频理解，数据视频理解更强调准确读取动画图表中的数据、跨图表和时间整合证据，以及理解叙事结构与视觉设计如何传递信息。然而，现有基准主要针对通用视频或静态图表，尚未对数据视频理解进行系统性评估。我们提出了DataVista，这是首个面向数据视频理解的基准，包含961个真实世界的数据视频和6,775个评估问题，按照三级渐进能力框架（数据感知、时间推理、叙事理解）组织，并涵盖五个主题领域的10种细粒度问题类型。对19个主流多模态大模型的系统评估显示，表现最佳的模型Gemini-3.1-Pro整体准确率为70.0%，仍远低于人类专家水平，尤其在因果推理和叙事结构方面表现最差。增加帧数和添加字幕主要提升了数据感知和时间推理能力，但在叙事理解方面改善有限。进一步分析模型回答识别出典型的失败模式，包括图表解读错误、证据判断偏差和指令理解失误。该基准已公开于https://github.com/HKUSTDial/DataVista。

summary: Research idea innovation is a fundamental engine of scientific progress, yet it remains difficult to generate and evaluate in a scalable and controllable way. This challenge lies in its inherently open-ended and multi-objective nature, where ideas should balance novelty, plausibility and feasibility. While recent LLM-based approaches have made progress through carefully designed prompts or agent pipelines, they are constrained by predefined, static ideation workflows. To address this limitation, we propose MindFlow, a framework that explicitly formulates ideation as a graph-structured Flow in Mind, which is composed of modular thinking operators and modeled by a probabilistic mind supernet. Given a research topic, a controller dynamically samples thinking flows to generate candidate ideas. This open-ended problem is optimized using a tournament-based relative ranking, enabling the controller to progressively favor higher-quality thinking flows. We further introduce an evaluation protocol that jointly assesses problem finding and problem solving, going beyond title- or abstractonly judgments. Across diverse topics, MindFlow shows its superiority as an explicit, controllable and optimizable research idea innovator.
title: MindFlow: Mind Supernet Powered Thinking Flows for Research Idea Innovation
title_translated: MindFlow：基于心智超网络的思维流，用于科研创意创新
summary_translated: 科研创意创新是科学进步的根本驱动力，但目前仍难以实现可扩展且可控的生成与评估。这一挑战源于其本质上开放且多目标的特性，要求创意在新颖性、合理性和可行性之间取得平衡。尽管近期基于大语言模型的方法通过精心设计的提示或代理流程取得进展，但仍受限于预定义的静态创意流程。为克服这一局限，我们提出MindFlow，一种将创意生成明确建模为心智中图结构思维流的框架，由模块化思维算子构成，并通过概率心智超网络进行建模。给定一个研究主题，控制器动态采样思维流以生成候选创意。这一开放性问题通过基于锦标赛的相对排序进行优化，使控制器逐步倾向于高质量的思维流。我们还引入了一种联合评估协议，同时评估问题发现与问题求解能力，超越仅基于标题或摘要的判断。在多种主题上，MindFlow展现出作为显式、可控且可优化的科研创意生成器的优势。

summary: Project Greenhouse represents our exploration of a simple thesis: We believe that it is possible to build fully open and sovereign models for agentic search with only modest computational resources. As a first milestone, we describe how to build a competitive pointwise decoder-only reranker using a simple two-step recipe comprising pre-training from scratch followed by supervised fine-tuning, starting only from commonly available datasets. Contrary to the dominant approach in the literature, we do not rely on existing open-weight backbones from third parties, and thus we are fully in control of model training, from end to end. We were able to accomplish the bulk of our experiments using no more than a handful of GPUs. This report articulates the importance and benefits of our approach, and we share artifacts that enable transparent, independent reproduction of all aspects of model training. Beyond data, code, and configurations that capture our efforts, we also release checkpoints for our family of Gaggle models, demonstrating the feasibility of our approach and providing a first step toward validating our broader thesis.
title: Project Greenhouse: Progress Toward Fully Open and Sovereign Agentic Search
title_translated: Project Greenhouse：迈向完全开源与主权化的智能体搜索
summary_translated: Project Greenhouse代表我们对一个简单论点的探索：我们认为，仅需适度的计算资源即可构建完全开源且主权化的智能体搜索模型。作为首个里程碑，我们描述了如何通过一个简单的两步法（从头开始预训练，随后进行监督微调）构建具有竞争力的点对点解码器重排序器，起始数据仅来自常见可用数据集。与文献中主流方法不同，我们不依赖第三方提供的开源权重主干模型，从而实现了从头到尾对模型训练的完全控制。我们仅使用少量GPU便完成了大部分实验。本报告阐述了该方法的重要性与优势，并分享了可实现所有模型训练环节透明、独立复现的成果。除了数据、代码和配置外，我们还发布了Gaggle系列模型的检查点，证明了该方法的可行性，并为验证我们更广泛的论点迈出了第一步。

summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) methods such as GRPO substantially improve large language model reasoning but often suffer from policy entropy collapse: the loss of sampling diversity weakens exploration and limits further improvement. Existing methods address this issue either through algorithm-level interventions, such as reward modification and entropy/KL regularization, or through token-level reweighting. We investigate a complementary perspective: entropy collapse can also be mitigated by changing which generated rollouts contribute to policy updates. Under the same sampling budget, not all rollouts contribute positively to an update, and selectively excluding some can improve learning. To address this, we propose GRPODropout: before the standard update, we use a simple strategy that selectively removes a small number of high-probability positive-advantage rollouts and recenters the retained advantages. To motivate this design, we develop a rollout-level theoretical analysis that guides method design and threshold selection. The method changes only rollout usage, and adds negligible computational overhead. Experiments show higher accuracy than original GRPO and higher actor entropy while using fewer rollout samples for updates, illustrating "less is more." This work provides insight into RL rollout usage: removing some rollouts can improve performance. Code is available at https://github.com/hexuandeng/GRPODropout/.
title: GRPODropout: Less is More for Online Reinforcement Learning Rollouts
title_translated: GRPODropout：在线强化学习回溯中，少即是多
summary_translated: 强化学习（RL）方法如GRPO显著提升了大语言模型的推理能力，但常常面临策略熵崩溃问题：采样多样性丧失削弱了探索能力，限制了进一步提升。现有方法通过算法层面干预（如奖励修改、熵/KL正则化）或标记层面重加权来解决此问题。我们提出一种互补视角：通过改变哪些生成的回溯路径参与策略更新，也能缓解熵崩溃。在相同的采样预算下，并非所有回溯路径都对更新有积极贡献，选择性排除部分路径可提升学习效果。为此，我们提出GRPODropout：在标准更新前，采用一种简单策略，有选择地移除少量高概率正优势回溯路径，并重新中心化保留的优势值。为支持该设计，我们构建了基于回溯层面的理论分析，指导方法设计与阈值选择。该方法仅改变回溯使用方式，计算开销极小。实验表明，相比原始GRPO，其准确率更高，同时在更少回溯样本下保持更高的演员熵，体现了“少即是多”的理念。本工作揭示了RL回溯使用的新见解：适当移除部分回溯路径可提升性能。代码已公开于 https://github.com/hexuandeng/GRPODropout。

summary: Learning to act in unfamiliar environments requires agents to infer how the world works and revise that understanding as new evidence arrives. Yet limited observations can support multiple world models that explain past interactions but predict different outcomes in unseen states. We introduce Memento 3, building on the Memento series to enable frozen LLM agents to continually learn explicit world models through external memory. The agent maintains a natural-language rulebook as persistent semantic memory, recording revisable hypotheses about environment dynamics while leaving unknown aspects underspecified. It compiles this rulebook into executable code for prediction and planning. Through a continual loop of observation, reflection, rule revision, compilation, and verification, the agent uses prediction errors to refine both the rulebook and its code. Updated code is accepted only when the LLM judges it faithful to the rulebook and cell-exact replay reproduces the observed transitions. We investigate this process as a model-based route to recursive self-improvement (RSI): the agent autonomously explores the environment, revises its world model, and uses verified updates to guide subsequent interaction and learning, while the underlying LLM remains fixed. A population extension maintains multiple world models in parallel, sharing interaction evidence and using their predictions to guide exploration. On ARC-AGI-3, the single-model agent clears every level of all 25 public games, achieves a mean Relative Human Action Efficiency (RHAE) of 100.0, and uses 44% of the human action count. In an Atari Pong case study, a learned feedback controller wins 21:0 in each of three evaluated episodes with different openings, without further LLM calls.
title: Memento 3: Model-Based Recursive Self-Improvement through Reflective Rulebooks
title_translated: Memento 3：基于反射规则书的基于模型递归自我改进
summary_translated: 在陌生环境中学习行动需要智能体推断世界运作机制，并随着新证据的到来不断修正理解。然而，有限的观察可能支持多个能解释过去交互但对未见状态预测不同的世界模型。我们提出Memento 3，延续Memento系列，使冻结的大语言模型智能体通过外部记忆持续学习显式的世界模型。该智能体维护一个以自然语言记录的规则书作为持久语义记忆，记录关于环境动态的可修订假设，同时对未知部分保持模糊。它将规则书编译为可执行代码用于预测和规划。通过观察、反思、规则修订、编译和验证的持续循环，智能体利用预测误差来优化规则书及其代码。只有当大语言模型判断更新后的代码忠实于规则书且单元精确回放能重现观测到的转移时，才接受更新。我们研究这一过程作为基于模型的递归自我改进（RSI）路径：智能体自主探索环境，修订世界模型，并用经验证的更新引导后续交互与学习，而底层大语言模型保持不变。群体扩展版本并行维护多个世界模型，共享交互证据，并利用其预测指导探索。在ARC-AGI-3上，单模型智能体清除了全部25个公开游戏的所有关卡，平均相对人类动作效率（RHAE）达到100.0，仅使用人类动作数量的44%。在Atari Pong案例研究中，学习到的反馈控制器在三个不同开局的评估回合中均以21:0获胜，且无需额外的大语言模型调用。

summary: Sparse Mixture of Experts (MoE) models scale more efficiently than dense models by routing tokens to modular expert networks that are only active for processing a fraction of tokens. A leading hypothesis for the performance of MoE models is that each expert specialises in a single, coherent domain. However, interpretability efforts that assume this hypothesis have generally been unsuccessful. We propose and present evidence for an alternative account that we call the Superposed Specialisation Hypothesis (SSH): experts specialise in a disjoint union of fine-grained features rather than one broad domain. Leveraging the SSH, we introduce RouterInterp, a method for interpreting expert routing that identifies Sparse Autoencoder features most predictive of routing decisions and produces unified natural language explanations. On gpt-oss-20b, RouterInterp explains expert routing with ${\sim}65\%$ higher detection accuracy than prior token statistics based methods. This work provides a scalable method for generating more accurate explanations of expert routing and increases our understanding of a previously uninterpretable component of foundation models.
title: RouterInterp: Understanding Superposed Specialisation in Mixture of Experts Routing
comment: 33 pages (12 non-appendix pages), 7 figures, published as a conference paper at ICML 2026
title_translated: RouterInterp：理解专家混合路由中的叠加专业化现象
summary_translated: 稀疏专家混合（MoE）模型通过将令牌路由至仅处理部分令牌的模块化专家网络，比密集模型更具可扩展性。目前主流假设是每个专家专门处理单一、连贯的领域。然而，基于该假设的可解释性研究普遍失败。我们提出并提供证据支持一种替代解释，称为叠加专业化假说（SSH）：专家并非专注于单一宽泛领域，而是专门处理一系列细粒度特征的不相交并集。基于SSH，我们提出RouterInterp，一种用于解释专家路由的方法，能够识别最能预测路由决策的稀疏自编码器特征，并生成统一的自然语言解释。在gpt-oss-20b模型上，RouterInterp的路由解释检测准确率比以往基于标记统计的方法高出约65%。本工作提供了一种可扩展的方法，生成更准确的专家路由解释，增进了我们对基础模型中此前不可解释组件的理解。

summary: We describe a 4-tensor attention model that predicts the next semantic state of a scene, for video generation and robot planning. A window of states has positions (x, t) and two fibers, a semantic fiber and a temporal-context fiber, and one softmax normalizes attention jointly over the window. Frames and an agent's situation are written as those states; the encoder, the renderer, and the planner remain outside the update. To test the update on its own, we train on ROCStories, where each window poses the same next-sentence task at the semantic layer. On the validation split, with one seed per setting, the last-sentence cross-entropy on the three matched settings is lower for the 4-tensor model than for a free-running one-dimensional transformer by 5.3% at H=2, L=2, by 2.6% at H=4, L=2, and by 2.4% at H=4, L=3. At H=4, L=2 the parameter counts are nearly the same, 172.5M and 175.9M. On the same two GPUs that 4-tensor run finished in 2.4 hours and the baseline run in 45.2 hours; the baseline is trained by free-running decoding, one sequential forward pass per target token.
title: 4-Tensor Attention Model for Semantic Physical Reality
title_translated: 用于语义物理现实的四张量注意力模型
